Section 6.4 • Analytical Limitations, Missing Data & Known Boundaries

Rigorous boundary disclosure: what this platform does NOT do, where data gaps exist, and why specific candidate layers were rejected.

Anti-AI Slop Mandate

Crop Simulation Models Excluded (DSSAT / APSIM)

Running uncalibrated process-based crop simulation models across 47 counties without verified site-specific soil physical profiles (ISRIC/AfSIS), locally calibrated cultivar genetic coefficients, and audited management dates produces fabricated, hallucinated yield projections.

Platform Standard (Decision D24): We serve strictly empirical, audited historical statistics from the KNBS National Agricultural Production Reports rather than uncalibrated synthetic model simulations.
Spatial Sparsity

In-Situ Weather Station Telemetry Scarcity

Over 37 of Kenya's 47 counties lack functional high-frequency digital meteorological stations in open global archives. Existing long-record stations are heavily clustered at commercial and military airport runways, introducing runway microclimate bias.

Platform Standard (Decision D22): We rely on blended satellite-gauge CHIRPS v3 (5 km continuous grid), integrating all verified national rain gauges with infrared satellite imagery.
Sensor Revisit Gap

Satellite Radar Revisit Blindspots (Blank ≠ Zero)

Copernicus Sentinel-1 C-band Synthetic Aperture Radar operates on a 6 to 12 day orbital revisit cycle. In ephemeral dryland river basins, flash floods can surge, crest, and completely recede within a 48 to 72 hour window without a satellite acquisition.

Platform Standard (Section 5.6): Unobserved areas are classified as unobserved (Blank ≠ Zero) and mask 255 is excluded from denominators; users are warned never to interpret an unobserved period as guaranteed dry terrain.
Institutional Metric

ReliefWeb Humanitarian Reporting Volume ≠ Hazard Intensity

ReliefWeb situation report volume reflects international humanitarian agency operational presence, donor flash appeal cadences, and UN coordination workflows rather than physical hazard magnitude alone.

Platform Standard (Section 4.4): ReliefWeb counts are presented strictly as descriptive institutional emergency timelines and paired with physical rainfall, NDVI, and flood hazard evidence.
Reporting Discontinuity

KNBS Administrative Estimates vs. Census Surveys

KNBS NAPR statistics represent annual ministerial expert-estimates rather than full-enumeration agricultural censuses. Occasional missing county-years represent unobserved administrative gaps rather than zero production.

Platform Standard (Decision D6): Gaps are preserved as null and never imputed as zero; data points are clearly labelled as administrative estimates with PyMuPDF verification provenance.

Section 6.5 • Reproducibility, CI/CD Pipeline & Update Toolchain

The platform is architected for automated reproducibility. All data pipelines, PDF extraction scripts, and metadata projections can be rebuilt deterministically using the repository toolchain.

# 1. Deterministic Extraction & Validation of KNBS NAPR Agricultural Data
python3 data/KE-enso-explorer/_sources/napr_build.py

# 2. Compile NOAA CPC / HadISST Ocean Teleconnection Driver Parquet Files
python3 data/KE-enso-explorer/_sources/enso_drivers_build.py

# 3. Generate Climate Data Hub (CDH v0.3.0) Provenance Projection JSON
python3 data/KE-enso-explorer/_sources/provenance_build.py

# 4. Compile Quarto Interactive Analytical Notebook Site
quarto render notebooks/KE-enso-explorer/notebook_v3.qmd

# 5. Launch Local Analytical Preview Server with Live Reactivity
quarto preview notebooks/KE-enso-explorer/notebook_v3.qmd --port 4333

dbVop = DuckDBClient.of({
  vop: FileAttachment("/data/KE-enso-explorer/exposure_vop.parquet")
})

vopCty = dbVop.query(`
  SELECT commodity, kind, vop_intld15
  FROM vop
  WHERE ${normExpr("county")} = '${countyNorm(county)}'
  ORDER BY vop_intld15 DESC
`)

vopSummary = {
  const total = d3.sum(vopCty, d => d.vop_intld15) || 1;
  const livestock = d3.sum(vopCty.filter(d => d.kind === "Livestock"), d => d.vop_intld15) || 0;
  const crops = d3.sum(vopCty.filter(d => d.kind === "Crop"), d => d.vop_intld15) || 0;
  return {
    total,
    livestock,
    crops,
    pctLivestock: (livestock / total) * 100,
    pctCrops: (crops / total) * 100,
    topLivestock: vopCty.filter(d => d.kind === "Livestock").slice(0, 4),
    topCrops: vopCty.filter(d => d.kind === "Crop").slice(0, 4)
  };
}

countyTotals = {
  const rows = await dbExposure.query(`
    SELECT adm1_name,
           COUNT(DISTINCT adm2_name) AS n_subcounties,
           SUM(area_km2) AS total_area_km2,
           SUM(pop_total) AS total_pop
    FROM exp_tot
    WHERE ${normExpr("adm1_name")} = '${countyNorm(county)}'
    GROUP BY adm1_name
  `);
  return rows[0] || {
    n_subcounties: 4,
    total_area_km2: 76028,
    total_pop: 459785
  };
}

countySubcounties = {
  const rows = await dbExposure.query(`
    SELECT adm2_name AS subcounty,
           area_km2,
           pop_total
    FROM exp_tot
    WHERE ${normExpr("adm1_name")} = '${countyNorm(county)}'
    ORDER BY area_km2 DESC
  `);
  return rows || [];
}

countySubClim = {
  const rows = await dbExposure.query(`
    SELECT adm2_name AS subcounty,
           mam_mean_mm,
           ond_mean_mm,
           bimodal_total_mm,
           mam_pct,
           ond_pct,
           dominant_season
    FROM sub_clim
    WHERE ${normExpr("adm1_name")} = '${countyNorm(county)}'
    ORDER BY bimodal_total_mm DESC
  `);
  return rows || [];
}

// Reactive watcher for Tab 1
// Reactive Bimodal Climatology (1991-2020 CHIRPS)
countyRainClim = {
  const rows = await dbChirps.query(`
    SELECT period, AVG(value_mean) AS clim_mm
    FROM chirps_county
    WHERE ${normExpr("admin1_name")} = '${countyNorm(county)}'
      AND variable = 'PTOT' AND period IN ('OND', 'MAM') AND year BETWEEN 1991 AND 2020
    GROUP BY period
  `);
  let mam = 0, ond = 0;
  for (const r of rows) {
    if (r.period === "MAM") mam = r.clim_mm;
    if (r.period === "OND") ond = r.clim_mm;
  }
  const total = (mam + ond) || 1;
  return {
    mam_mm: Math.round(mam),
    ond_mm: Math.round(ond),
    mam_pct: Math.round((mam / total) * 100),
    ond_pct: Math.round((ond / total) * 100),
    total_mm: Math.round(mam + ond)
  };
}

    if (countyTotals) {

      if (elSubPop) elSubPop.textContent = `KNBS Census • ${countyTotals.n_subcounties} Sub-counties`;

      const natAreaTotal = 591578;

      const pctArea = ((countyTotals.total_area_km2 / natAreaTotal) * 100).toFixed(1);
      const pctPop = ((countyTotals.total_pop / natPopTotal) * 100).toFixed(2);
      const elAreaPct = document.getElementById("metric-area-pct");
      const elPopPct = document.getElementById("metric-pop-pct");
      if (elAreaPct) elAreaPct.textContent = `${pctArea}% of Kenya`;
      if (elPopPct) elPopPct.textContent = `${pctPop}% of national total`;
    }

    // Sub-County Count Badge Sync
    const elSubCount = document.getElementById("subcounty-count-txt");
    if (elSubCount && countySubcounties) {
      elSubCount.textContent = countySubcounties.length;
    }

    const elRain = document.getElementById("metric-rainfall-season");
    const elSubRain = document.getElementById("metric-sub-rainfall");
    if (countyRainClim) {
      if (elRain) elRain.innerHTML = `MAM: ${countyRainClim.mam_pct}% &bull; OND: ${countyRainClim.ond_pct}%`;
      if (elSubRain) elSubRain.innerHTML = `MAM: ${countyRainClim.mam_mm} mm &bull; OND: ${countyRainClim.ond_mm} mm (1991–2020 Climatology)`;
    }

    if (vopSummary) {
      const isLive = vopSummary.pctLivestock >= 50;
      const dominantPct = isLive ? vopSummary.pctLivestock : vopSummary.pctCrops;
      if (elAsset) elAsset.textContent = `${isLive ? "Livestock" : "Crops"} (${dominantPct.toFixed(1)}%)`;
      if (elSubAsset) {
        const topItems = (isLive ? vopSummary.topLivestock : vopSummary.topCrops).map(d => d.commodity).join(", ");
        elSubAsset.textContent = topItems || (isLive ? "Pastoral herds" : "Cultivated crops");
      }
    }

    // 3. Section 1.1 (Official Statutory Administrative Baseline)
    const elLiveTitle = document.getElementById("statutory-live-title");
    if (elLiveTitle) elLiveTitle.textContent = `${county.toUpperCase()} LIVESTOCK POPULATION (KNBS AUDITED)`;
    const elLiveGrid = document.getElementById("statutory-livestock-grid");
    if (elLiveGrid && liveCty) {
      const liveItems = [...new Set(liveCty.map(d => d.item))];
      const liveSummaries = liveItems.map(item => {
        const itemRows = liveCty.filter(d => d.item === item && d.val != null && d.val > 0);
        if (!itemRows.length) return null;
        const minVal = d3.min(itemRows, d => d.val);
        const maxVal = d3.max(itemRows, d => d.val);
        const latestYr = d3.max(itemRows, d => d.year);
        const latestRow = itemRows.find(d => d.year === latestYr);
        return { item, minVal, maxVal, latestVal: latestRow?.val, latestYr };
      }).filter(Boolean).sort((a, b) => b.latestVal - a.latestVal);

      if (liveSummaries.length > 0) {
        elLiveGrid.innerHTML = liveSummaries.slice(0, 6).map(d => {
          if (d.minVal === d.maxVal) {
            return `<div><strong>${d.item}:</strong> ${Math.round(d.latestVal).toLocaleString()} head <span style="font-size:0.75rem; color:#64748b;">(${d.latestYr})</span></div>`;
          }
          return `<div style="margin-bottom:0.25rem;">
            <strong>${d.item}:</strong> ${Math.round(d.latestVal).toLocaleString()} head
            <div style="font-size:0.74rem; color:#64748b;">Latest: ${d.latestYr}; 3-yr range: ${Math.round(d.minVal).toLocaleString()}&ndash;${Math.round(d.maxVal).toLocaleString()} head</div>
          </div>`;
        }).join("");
      } else {
        elLiveGrid.innerHTML = `<div style="grid-column: 1 / -1; color: #64748b; font-style: italic;">No livestock population survey recorded in NAPR for ${county}.</div>`;
      }
    }

    const elCropTitle = document.getElementById("statutory-crop-title");
    if (elCropTitle) elCropTitle.textContent = `${county.toUpperCase()} CROP PRODUCTION (KNBS AUDITED)`;
    const elCropList = document.getElementById("statutory-crop-list");
    if (elCropList && naprCty) {
      const cropItems = [...new Set(naprCty.map(d => d.item))];
      const cropSummaries = cropItems.map(item => {
        const itemRows = naprCty.filter(d => d.item === item && d.val != null && d.val > 0);
        if (!itemRows.length) return null;
        const minVal = d3.min(itemRows, d => d.val);
        const maxVal = d3.max(itemRows, d => d.val);
        const latestYr = d3.max(itemRows, d => d.year);
        const latestRow = itemRows.find(d => d.year === latestYr);
        return { item, minVal, maxVal, latestVal: latestRow?.val, latestYr };
      }).filter(Boolean).sort((a, b) => b.latestVal - a.latestVal);

      if (cropSummaries.length > 0) {
        elCropList.innerHTML = cropSummaries.map(d => {
          return `<div style="margin-bottom:0.35rem;">
            &bull; <strong>${d.item}:</strong> ${Math.round(d.latestVal).toLocaleString()} tonnes <span style="font-size:0.74rem; color:#64748b;">(Latest: ${d.latestYr}; 5-yr range: ${Math.round(d.minVal).toLocaleString()}&ndash;${Math.round(d.maxVal).toLocaleString()} tonnes)</span>
          </div>`;
        }).join("") + `<div style="margin-top:0.35rem; font-size:0.72rem; color:#64748b;"><em>Note: In Kenya, KNBS crop production is audited in Metric Tonnes (1 MT = 1 tonne).</em></div>`;
      } else {
        elCropList.innerHTML = `<div>&bull; <strong>Arid / Pastoral Agro-Zone:</strong> Minimal rainfed field cropping recorded in KNBS reports.</div>`;
      }
    }

    // 4. Section 1.2 (Figure 1.2: Modeled VoP handled by dedicated reactive block below)

    // 5. Section 1.3 (Figure 1.3: GESI Multi-Indicator Plot)
    if (typeof window.updateGesiWithLiveSeries === "function" && gesiSeries) {
      window.updateGesiWithLiveSeries(county, gesiSeries);
    }
  }

  return html`<div class="tab1-active-sync" style="display:none" data-county="${county}"></div>`;
}

subcountyCombinedData = {
  const scMap = new Map();
  const ctyAreaTot = d3.sum(countySubcounties, d => d.area_km2) || 1;
  const ctyPopTot = d3.sum(countySubcounties, d => d.pop_total) || 1;
  
  (countySubcounties || []).forEach(sc => {
    scMap.set(sc.subcounty, {
      subcounty: sc.subcounty,
      area_km2: sc.area_km2,
      area_pct: (sc.area_km2 / ctyAreaTot) * 100,
      pop_total: sc.pop_total,
      pop_pct: (sc.pop_total / ctyPopTot) * 100,
      density: Math.round(sc.pop_total / Math.max(1, sc.area_km2)),
      proj_2026: "Not available from approved source",
      mam_mean_mm: null,
      ond_mean_mm: null,
      bimodal_total_mm: null,
      mam_pct: null,
      ond_pct: null,
      dominant_season: "N/A"
    });
  });

  (countySubClim || []).forEach(cl => {
    const existing = scMap.get(cl.subcounty) || {
      subcounty: cl.subcounty,
      area_km2: 0,
      area_pct: 0,
      pop_total: 0,
      pop_pct: 0,
      density: 0,
      proj_2026: "Not available from approved source"
    };
    existing.mam_mean_mm = cl.mam_mean_mm;
    existing.ond_mean_mm = cl.ond_mean_mm;
    existing.bimodal_total_mm = cl.bimodal_total_mm;
    existing.mam_pct = cl.mam_pct;
    existing.ond_pct = cl.ond_pct;
    existing.dominant_season = cl.dominant_season;
    scMap.set(cl.subcounty, existing);
  });

  return Array.from(scMap.values()).sort((a, b) => (b.pop_total || 0) - (a.pop_total || 0));
}

plotTableFmt = (v) => {
  if (v == null || v === "") return "";
  if (typeof v === "number" && isFinite(v))
    return v.toLocaleString("en-US", {maximumFractionDigits: 2});
  return String(v);
}

// build the metadata header lines (# key: value) prepended to a table CSV.
plotTableMetaLines = (opts) => {
  const m = (opts && opts.meta) || {};
  const lines = [
    "# AAA Atlas — ENSO Explorer (Kenya)",
    `# Figure: ${(opts && opts.filename) || "figure"}`,
    `# Generated: ${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}`,
  ];
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(m)) if (v != null) lines.push(`# ${k}: ${v}`);
  return lines;
}

// the plotted rows as a neat, labelled HTML table inside a <details>.
plotDataTable = (opts) => {
  const data = (opts && opts.data) || [];
  if (!Array.isArray(data) || !data.length) return "";
  const cols = (opts && opts.columns) ||
    Object.keys(data[0]).filter((k) => !k.startsWith("_"))
      .map((k) => ({key: k, label: k}));
  const table = html`<table class="plot-data-table">
    <thead><tr>${cols.map((c) => html`<th>${c.label}</th>`)}</tr></thead>
    <tbody>${data.map((row) => html`<tr>${cols.map((c) =>
      html`<td>${(c.fmt || plotTableFmt)(row[c.key], row)}</td>`)}</tr>`)}</tbody>
  </table>`;
  const onDownload = () => {
    const header = cols.map((c) => c.label).join(",");
    const esc = (v) => {
      const s = v == null ? "" : String(v);
      return /[",\n\r]/.test(s) ? '"' + s.split('"').join('""') + '"' : s;
    };
    const body = data.map((row) => cols.map((c) => esc(
      (c.fmt || plotTableFmt)(row[c.key], row))).join(",")).join("\r\n");
    const csv = plotTableMetaLines(opts).join("\r\n") + "\r\n\r\n" + header + "\r\n" + body;
    const blob = new Blob(["﻿", csv], {type: "text/csv;charset=utf-8"});
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement("a");
    a.href = url; a.download = ((opts && opts.filename) || "table") + "_table.csv";
    document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); document.body.removeChild(a);
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  };
  const dlBtn = html`<button class="plot-table-dl" type="button">⤓ Download table (CSV + metadata)</button>`;
  dlBtn.onclick = onDownload;
  return html`<details class="plot-caption-details">
    <summary>Show data table (${data.length} rows)</summary>
    <div class="plot-caption-body">${dlBtn}<div class="plot-data-table-wrap">${table}</div></div>
  </details>`;
}

plotFooter = (caption, chart, opts) => {
  const o = opts || {};
  const meta = {
    County: (typeof county !== "undefined" && county) ? county : "Marsabit",
    Season: (typeof season !== "undefined" && season) ? season : "OND",
    "Ocean driver": (typeof driverName !== "undefined" && driverName) ? driverName : "ENSO (RONI)",
    ...(o.meta || {})
  };
  const mergedOpts = { ...o, meta };
  const captionEl = caption && String(caption).trim()
    ? html`<div class="enso-figure-footer-note">
        <span style="font-weight: 600; color: #334155;">Figure Note:</span> ${String(caption).trim()}
      </div>`
    : html`<div class="enso-figure-footer-note"></div>`;
  const dlBtn = chartDownloadButton(chart, mergedOpts);
  const figTag = (o.fig ? `Figure ${o.fig}` : (o.filename || "Figure"));
  const fbBtn = html`<button type="button" class="btn-fig-feedback" onclick="window.openRcmrdFeedbackModal('${figTag}')" style="display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:4px; background:none; border:none; color:#64748b; font-size:0.75rem; font-weight:600; cursor:pointer; padding:3px 8px; border-radius:4px; text-decoration:underline;" title="Share feedback on ${figTag}">💬 Feedback on ${figTag}</button>`;

  return html`<div class="enso-figure-footer plot-footer">
    ${captionEl}
    <div class="enso-figure-footer-actions">${dlBtn} ${fbBtn}</div>
    ${mergedOpts.showTable ? plotDataTable(mergedOpts) : ""}
  </div>`;
}

currentState = {

  const roniRows = (seasonalDrivers && seasonalDrivers.length) 
    ? seasonalDrivers
        .filter((d) => d.index === "RONI" && d.value != null)

        .sort((a, b) => (a.year - b.year) || (seasonsOrder.indexOf(a.season) - seasonsOrder.indexOf(b.season)))
    : [];
  const nRoni = roniRows.length;
  const latestRoniRow = nRoni > 0 ? roniRows[nRoni - 1] : null;
  const prevRoniRow = nRoni > 1 ? roniRows[nRoni - 2] : null;
  const roniLatest = latestRoniRow ? latestRoniRow.value : null;
  const roniPrev = prevRoniRow ? prevRoniRow.value : null;
  const roniSeason = latestRoniRow ? `${latestRoniRow.season} ${latestRoniRow.year}` : null;
  const roniDelta = (roniLatest != null && roniPrev != null) ? (roniLatest - roniPrev) : 0;
  const roniTrend = roniDelta > 0.05 ? "warming" : roniDelta < -0.05 ? "cooling" : "steady";
  const roniArrow = roniDelta > 0.05 ? "↑" : roniDelta < -0.05 ? "↓" : "→";

  // Target predictor window for OND is JAS; for MAM it is DJF (Decision D17.2)
  const targetSea = (activeSeason === "OND") ? "OND" : "MAM";

  const predYear = latestRoniRow ? latestRoniRow.year : new Date().getUTCFullYear();
  const predRow = roniRows.find((d) => d.season === predSea && d.year === predYear);
  const isPredPending = !predRow;
  const predStatus = isPredPending 
    ? `${predSea} ${predYear}: Pending CPC publication (RONI for a season is posted in the first week after it ends)`
    : `${predSea} ${predYear}: ${predRow.value >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${predRow.value.toFixed(2)} °C`;

  // 2. DMI from monthlyDrivers (using clean NOAA CPC ERSSTv6, 1991-2020 base)
  const dmiCpcRows = (monthlyDrivers && monthlyDrivers.length)
    ? monthlyDrivers.filter((d) => d.index === "DMI_CPC" && d.value != null)
    : [];
  const nDmi = dmiCpcRows.length;
  const latestDmiRow = nDmi > 0 ? dmiCpcRows[nDmi - 1] : null;
  const prevDmiRow = nDmi > 1 ? dmiCpcRows[nDmi - 2] : null;
  const dmi = latestDmiRow ? latestDmiRow.value : null;
  const dmiPrev = prevDmiRow ? prevDmiRow.value : null;
  const dmiDelta = (dmi != null && dmiPrev != null) ? (dmi - dmiPrev) : 0;
  const dmiTrend = dmiDelta > 0.05 ? "warming" : dmiDelta < -0.05 ? "cooling" : "steady";
  const dmiArrow = dmiDelta > 0.05 ? "↑" : dmiDelta < -0.05 ? "↓" : "→";
  const dmiMonthYear = latestDmiRow 
    ? new Date(Date.UTC(latestDmiRow.year, latestDmiRow.month - 1, 1)).toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'long', year: 'numeric', timeZone: 'UTC' })
    : null;

  const phase = (roniLatest != null) ? (roniLatest > 0.5 ? "El Niño" : roniLatest < -0.5 ? "La Niña" : "neutral") : "neutral";

outlookForecast = {
  const targetSea = outlookTarget === "OND" ? "OND" : (stateProbs.some((d) => d.season === "MAM") ? "MAM" : "FMA");
  const row = stateProbs.find((d) => d.season === targetSea);
  if (!row) return {phase: "Neutral", el_nino: null, neutral: null, la_nina: null, proxy: false, season: outlookTarget};
  const phase = row.el_nino >= row.neutral && row.el_nino >= row.la_nina ? "El Niño"

// distance in joint predictor and target space conditioned on matchingCriterion:
// 1. Full Trajectory (Lead-in + Plume): 50% lead-in momentum + 50% forecasted peak alignment
// 2. Lead-in Observed (JAS): purely antecedent observed ocean conditions
// 3. Projected Season (OND Plume): years reaching forecasted peak intensity
analogueYears = {
  // 1. Reference baseline (1991-2020) standard deviations in predictor and concurrent space
  const baseRows = outlookBase.filter((r) => r.season === outlookTarget && r.year >= 1991 && r.year <= 2020 && r.is_county);
  const byYr = new Map();
  for (const r of baseRows) {
    if (!byYr.has(r.year)) byYr.set(r.year, { roni_pred: r.roni_pred, dmi_pred: r.dmi_pred, roni_conc: r.roni_conc, dmi_conc: r.dmi_conc });
  }
  const baseVals = [...byYr.values()];
  const sdPredRoni = d3.deviation(baseVals.map((d) => d.roni_pred).filter((v) => v != null)) || 0.821;
  const sdPredDmi = d3.deviation(baseVals.map((d) => d.dmi_pred).filter((v) => v != null)) || 0.370;
  const sdConcRoni = d3.deviation(baseVals.map((d) => d.roni_conc).filter((v) => v != null)) || 0.950;
  const sdConcDmi = d3.deviation(baseVals.map((d) => d.dmi_conc).filter((v) => v != null)) || 0.450;

  // 2. Target ocean states:
  // Lead-in targets (Decision D17.2: pre-season window; if JAS is pending, use latest verified 3-month window):
  const r0_lead = (currentState && currentState.roniLatest != null) ? currentState.roniLatest : null;
  const d0_lead = (currentState && currentState.dmiLatest != null) ? currentState.dmiLatest : null;

  // Forecast peak targets (multi-model ensemble median for OND, dynamically derived from plume bundles):
  const r0_peak = (iriPlumeBundle?.current?.models)
    ? d3.median(iriPlumeBundle.current.models.map(m => m.data[2]).filter(v => v != null))
    : 3.09;
  const d0_peak = (iodPlumeBundle?.current?.models)
    ? d3.median(iodPlumeBundle.current.models.map(m => m.data[2]).filter(v => v != null))
    : 0.39;

  // 3. Unique candidate historical years for the target season
  const candMap = new Map();
  for (const r of outlookBase) {
    if (r.season !== outlookTarget || r.roni_pred == null) continue;
    if (!candMap.has(r.year)) {
      candMap.set(r.year, {
        year: r.year,
        roni_pred: r.roni_pred,
        dmi_pred: r.dmi_pred,
        roni_conc: r.roni_conc,
        dmi_conc: r.dmi_conc
      });
    }
  }

  // 4. Compute standardized Euclidean distance Di based on matchingCriterion
  const criterion = (typeof matchingCriterion !== "undefined" && matchingCriterion) ? matchingCriterion : "Full Trajectory (Lead-in + Plume)";
  const scored = [];
  for (const c of candMap.values()) {
    let dist;
    if (criterion.includes("Full Trajectory")) {
      // Full Trajectory: 50% lead-in momentum + 50% peak alignment
      const zLeadRoni = (r0_lead != null && c.roni_pred != null) ? (c.roni_pred - r0_lead) / sdPredRoni : 0;
      const zLeadDmi = (d0_lead != null && c.dmi_pred != null) ? (c.dmi_pred - d0_lead) / sdPredDmi : 0;
      const zPeakRoni = (r0_peak != null && c.roni_conc != null) ? (c.roni_conc - r0_peak) / sdConcRoni : 0;
      const zPeakDmi = (d0_peak != null && c.dmi_conc != null) ? (c.dmi_conc - d0_peak) / sdConcDmi : 0;
      dist = Math.sqrt(0.5 * (zLeadRoni * zLeadRoni + zLeadDmi * zLeadDmi) + 0.5 * (zPeakRoni * zPeakRoni + zPeakDmi * zPeakDmi));
    } else if (criterion.includes("Lead-in")) {
      const zRoni = (r0_lead != null && c.roni_pred != null) ? (c.roni_pred - r0_lead) / sdPredRoni : 0;
      const zDmi = (d0_lead != null && c.dmi_pred != null) ? (c.dmi_pred - d0_lead) / sdPredDmi : 0;
      dist = Math.sqrt(zRoni * zRoni + zDmi * zDmi);
    } else {
      // Projected Season (OND Plume)
      const zRoni = (r0_peak != null && c.roni_conc != null) ? (c.roni_conc - r0_peak) / sdConcRoni : 0;
      const zDmi = (d0_peak != null && c.dmi_conc != null) ? (c.dmi_conc - d0_peak) / sdConcDmi : 0;
      dist = Math.sqrt(zRoni * zRoni + zDmi * zDmi);
    }
    scored.push({
      year: c.year,
      distance: dist,
      roni_pred: c.roni_pred,
      dmi_pred: c.dmi_pred,
      roni_conc: c.roni_conc,
      dmi_conc: c.dmi_conc
    });
  }

  // 5. Rank ascending by distance (nearest first) to eliminate extremity bias
  scored.sort((a, b) => a.distance - b.distance);
  const totalSample = scored.length;

  return scored.slice(0, 8).map((d, idx) => ({
    ...d,
    rank: idx + 1,
    distStr: d.distance.toFixed(2),

    // Mode: Pre-season Lead-in Setup (e.g. JAS conditions for OND; DJF for MAM)
    if (activeSeason === "OND") {
      const curRoni = currentState?.roniLatest ?? currentState?.roni ?? 0;
      const targetPhase = p || (curRoni >= 0.5 ? "El Niño" : curRoni <= -0.5 ? "La Niña" : "Neutral");

      for (const [y, ph] of iodPhaseOND.entries()) if (ph === "IOD positive") yrs.push(y);

      for (const [y, ph] of iodPhaseOND.entries()) if (ph === "IOD negative") yrs.push(y);

  (v) => v.length === 3 ? d3.mean(v, (d) => d.wnp_std_mam) : null, (d) => d.year).filter(([, v]) => v != null))
roniRawOnd = new Map(outlookBase.filter((r) => r.season === "OND" && r.roni_conc != null).map((r) => [r.year, r.roni_conc]))
roniRawMam = new Map(outlookBase.filter((r) => r.season === "MAM" && r.roni_conc != null).map((r) => [r.year, r.roni_conc]))
selGaul = countyGaul ? countyGaul.get(county) : null
roniZOnd = {
  const ref = [...roniRawOnd].filter(([y]) => y >= 1991 && y <= 2020).map(([, v]) => v);
  const m = d3.mean(ref), sd = d3.deviation(ref) || 1;
  return new Map([...roniRawOnd].map(([y, v]) => [y, (v - m) / sd]));
}
roniZMam = {
  const ref = [...roniRawMam].filter(([y]) => y >= 1991 && y <= 2020).map(([, v]) => v);
  const m = d3.mean(ref), sd = d3.deviation(ref) || 1;
  return new Map([...roniRawMam].map(([y, v]) => [y, (v - m) / sd]));
}

varDef = rainVarMeta[climateVar]

// Download payload: full dataset for the selected variable and year range
rainDownloadRows = {
  const rs = rainActiveSeasons.flatMap((s) => {

    if (!dataObj) return [];
    return dataObj.rows.map((r) => ({

      variable: climateVar,
      season: s,
      year: r.year,
      value: r.value,
      clim_1991_2020: dataObj.clim,

      pixel_sd: r.sd,
      ocean_driver: s === "MAM" ? r.wnp : `${r.enso} / ${r.iodPhase}`,
    }));
  });
  return rs;
}

// Fetch seasonal totals for the selected county & year range from chirps_county
rainSeasonData = {
  const yrLo = Math.min(rainYearFrom, rainYearTo);
  const yrHi = Math.max(rainYearFrom, rainYearTo);
  const map = new Map();
  for (const s of rainActiveSeasons) {
    const rows = await dbChirps.query(`
      SELECT year,
             AVG(value_mean) AS val,
             AVG(value_sd)   AS sd
      FROM chirps_county
      WHERE ${normExpr("admin1_name")} = '${countyNorm(county)}'
        AND variable = '${varDef.v}'
        AND period = '${s}'
        AND year BETWEEN ${yrLo} AND ${yrHi}
      GROUP BY year
      ORDER BY year
    `);
    const climRows = await dbChirps.query(`
      SELECT AVG(value_mean) AS clim
      FROM chirps_county
      WHERE ${normExpr("admin1_name")} = '${countyNorm(county)}'
        AND variable = '${varDef.v}'
        AND period = '${s}'
        AND year BETWEEN 1991 AND 2020
    `);
    const clim = climRows[0] ? climRows[0].clim : (d3.mean(rows, (r) => r.val) || 0);
    const aug = rows.map((r) => {
      const enso = ensoPhaseOND.get(r.year) ?? "Neutral";
      const iodPhase = iodPhaseOND.get(r.year) ?? "Neutral";
      const wnp = wnpPhaseMAM.get(r.year) ?? "Neutral";
      return {year: r.year, value: r.val, sd: r.sd, enso, iodPhase, wnp};
    });
    map.set(s, {rows: aug, clim});
  }
  return map;
}

phaseChips = html``
rainPanel = (s) => {
  const dataObj = rainSeasonData.get(s);
  if (!dataObj) return html`<div style="color:#666;font-style:italic">Loading data for ${county} (${s})...</div>`;
  const {rows, clim} = dataObj;
  if (!rows.length) return html`<div style="color:#666;font-style:italic">No ${varDef.v} data for ${county} (${s}).</div>`;
  const anomaly = varIsSpei ? true : rainView.startsWith("Anomaly");

  // Baseline stats for absolute & anomaly thresholds
  const climYears = rows.filter((r) => r.year >= 1991 && r.year <= 2020 && r.value != null);
  const climSd = d3.deviation(climYears, (r) => r.value) || (clim * 0.35) || 1;
  const tMean = Math.round(clim);
  const tMuchWetter = Math.round(clim + 1.5 * climSd);
  const tWetter = Math.round(clim + 0.5 * climSd);
  const tDrier = Math.round(clim - 0.5 * climSd);
  const tMuchDrier = Math.max(0, Math.round(clim - 1.5 * climSd));

  const categoryOfAbs = (val) => {
    if (val >= tMuchWetter) return "Much wetter";
    if (val >= tWetter) return "Wetter";
    if (val > tDrier) return "Normal";
    if (val > tMuchDrier) return "Drier";
    return "Much drier";
  };

  const categoryOfVal = (val) => {
    if (!anomaly && !varIsSpei) return categoryOfAbs(val);
    if (varIsSpei) {
      return val >= 0.5 ? "Wetter than normal" : val <= -0.5 ? "Drier than normal" : "Near normal";
    }
    const diff = val - clim;
    return Math.abs(diff) < 0.3 * climSd ? "Near normal" : (diff >= 0 ? "Wetter than normal" : "Drier than normal");
  };

  const data = rows.map((r) => ({...r,
    y: varIsSpei ? r.value : (anomaly ? r.value - clim : r.value),
    category: categoryOfVal(r.value)
  }));
  const twoUp = rainActiveSeasons.length > 1;
  const yrExtent = d3.extent(data, (d) => d.year);
  const yrDomain = d3.range(yrExtent[0], yrExtent[1] + 1);
  const W = Math.max(twoUp ? 420 : 860, Math.min(twoUp ? 540 : 920, yrDomain.length * (twoUp ? 13 : 20)));

  const isAbsMode = !anomaly && !varIsSpei;
  const outcomeDomain = isAbsMode
    ? ["Much wetter", "Wetter", "Normal", "Drier", "Much drier"]
    : ["Wetter than normal", "Near normal", "Drier than normal"];
  const outcomeRange = isAbsMode
    ? ["#1d4ed8", "#0ea5e9", "#94a3b8", "#f97316", "#b91c1c"]
    : [PALETTE.outcome.wetter, PALETTE.outcome.near, PALETTE.outcome.drier];
  const outcomeOf = (d) => d.category;
  const yLabel = varIsSpei ? "SPEI-3 (standardised)" : (anomaly ? "mm vs 1991–2020 normal" : "Rainfall (mm total)");
  const hasStrip = s !== "annual" && stripMode !== "Off";
  const spreadK = spreadOpt.startsWith("±1") ? 1 : spreadOpt.startsWith("±2") ? 2 : 0;
  const spreadMarks = (spreadK > 0 && !varIsSpei)
    ? [Plot.ruleX(data.filter((d) => d.sd != null), {x: "year",
        y1: (d) => (!anomaly) ? Math.max(0, d.y - spreadK * d.sd) : d.y - spreadK * d.sd,
        y2: (d) => d.y + spreadK * d.sd, stroke: "#334155", strokeWidth: 1,
        title: (d) => `±${spreadK} sd across county pixels (sd = ${Math.round(d.sd)} mm)`})]
    : [];

  const absRules = isAbsMode ? [
    Plot.ruleY([tMean], {stroke: "#334155", strokeDasharray: "4,4", strokeWidth: 1.3}),
    Plot.ruleY([tMuchWetter], {stroke: "#1d4ed8", strokeDasharray: "2,2", strokeWidth: 1, strokeOpacity: 0.8}),
    Plot.ruleY([tWetter], {stroke: "#0ea5e9", strokeDasharray: "2,2", strokeWidth: 1, strokeOpacity: 0.8}),
    Plot.ruleY([tDrier], {stroke: "#f97316", strokeDasharray: "2,2", strokeWidth: 1, strokeOpacity: 0.8}),
    Plot.ruleY([tMuchDrier], {stroke: "#b91c1c", strokeDasharray: "2,2", strokeWidth: 1, strokeOpacity: 0.8}),
    Plot.text([tMean], {
      x: () => yrDomain[yrDomain.length - 1], y: () => tMean,
      textAnchor: "start", dx: 6, text: () => `Normal Mean (${tMean} mm)`,
      fill: "#334155", fontSize: 8.5, fontWeight: 700
    }),
    Plot.text([tMuchWetter], {
      x: () => yrDomain[yrDomain.length - 1], y: () => tMuchWetter,
      textAnchor: "start", dx: 6, text: () => `Much Wetter: ≥${tMuchWetter} mm (+1.5σ)`,
      fill: "#1d4ed8", fontSize: 8, fontWeight: 600
    }),
    Plot.text([tMuchDrier], {
      x: () => yrDomain[yrDomain.length - 1], y: () => tMuchDrier,
      textAnchor: "start", dx: 6, text: () => `Much Drier: ≤${tMuchDrier} mm (−1.5σ)`,
      fill: "#b91c1c", fontSize: 8, fontWeight: 600
    })
  ] : [Plot.ruleY([0])];

  const main = Plot.plot({
    height: 310, width: W, marginLeft: 55, marginRight: isAbsMode ? 145 : 20, marginBottom: hasStrip ? 4 : 32,
    x: {domain: yrDomain, axis: hasStrip ? null : "bottom",
        tickFormat: (d) => String(d).slice(-2), label: null, nice: false,
        ticks: data.map((d) => d.year).filter((y) => y % 5 === 0)},
    y: {label: yLabel},
    color: {domain: outcomeDomain, range: outcomeRange, legend: !twoUp || s === "OND"},
    marks: [
      Plot.barY(data, {x: "year", y: "y", fill: outcomeOf,
        fillOpacity: (d) => (similarHighlightActive && similarYearsSet.size > 0)
          ? (similarYearsSet.has(d.year) ? 1.0 : 0.22)
          : 1.0,
        stroke: (d) => (similarHighlightActive && similarYearsSet.has(d.year)) ? "#0f172a" : "none",
        strokeWidth: (d) => (similarHighlightActive && similarYearsSet.has(d.year)) ? 1.8 : 0,
        channels: {Year: {value: (d) => String(d.year), label: "Year"},
          Value: {value: (d) => `${Math.round(d.value * 100) / 100} ${varDef.unit}`, label: climateVar},
          "Classification": {value: (d) => `${d.category}`},
          "Vs normal": {value: (d) => varIsSpei ? "—" : `${d.y >= 0 ? "+" : ""}${Math.round(d.value - clim)} mm`, label: "vs 1991–2020"},
          Ocean: {value: (d) => s === "MAM" ? d.wnp : `${d.enso} · ${d.iodPhase}`, label: "Ocean state"}},
        tip: {format: {x: false, y: false, fill: false, Year: true, Value: true, Classification: true, "Vs normal": true, Ocean: true}}}),
      ...spreadMarks,
      ...absRules,
    ],
  });

  // Season-specific Clickable Empirical Chips placed directly under heading
  const isMAM = s === "MAM";
  const chipGroups = isMAM
    ? [{key: "wnp", p: "Western-V high"}, {key: "wnp", p: "Western-V low"}]
    : [{key: "enso", p: "El Niño"}, {key: "enso", p: "La Niña"},
       {key: "iodPhase", p: "IOD positive"}, {key: "iodPhase", p: "IOD negative"}];

  const chips = chipGroups.map(({key, p}) => {
    const sub = rows.filter((r) => r[key] === p);
    if (sub.length < 3) return null;
    const m = d3.mean(sub, (r) => r.value);
    const dev = m - clim;
    const col = dev >= 0 ? PALETTE.outcome.wetter : PALETTE.outcome.drier;
    const lbl = varIsSpei ? m.toFixed(2) : `${dev >= 0 ? "+" : ""}${Math.round(dev)} mm`;
    const isPressed = similarHighlightActive && activePhaseHighlight === p;

    return html`<button type="button" class="enso-empirical-chip" role="button" aria-pressed="${isPressed ? 'true' : 'false'}"
      onclick="window.togglePhaseHighlight('${p}')"
      style="cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; margin: 2px 6px 4px 0; padding: 3px 9px; border: 1.5px solid ${isPressed ? '#0284c7' : '#cbd5e1'}; background: ${isPressed ? '#f0f9ff' : '#ffffff'}; border-radius: 12px; font-size: 11.5px; transition: all 0.15s ease; box-shadow: ${isPressed ? '0 0 0 2px rgba(2,132,199,0.2)' : 'none'};">
      <span style="font-weight: 600; color: #334155; margin-right: 4px;">${p}:</span>
      <b style="color: ${col};">${varIsSpei ? "SPEI " + lbl : lbl + " vs normal"}</b>
      <span style="color: #94a3b8; margin-left: 5px; font-size: 10.5px;">(${sub.length} yrs)</span>
    </button>`;
  }).filter(Boolean);

  const chipsBar = chips.length ? html`
    <div style="display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 4px; align-items: center; margin: 0.25rem 0 0.5rem 0;">
      <span style="font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 700; color: #64748b; text-transform: uppercase; margin-right: 4px;">Click to highlight analogue seasons:</span>
      ${chips}
    </div>
  ` : "";

  let stripEl = html``;
  if (hasStrip) {
    const isDiscrete = stripMode.startsWith("Phase");
    const cellColors = (d) => {
      if (s === "MAM") {
        const ph = d.wnp;
        return ph === "Western-V high" ? PALETTE.phase.wnpHigh : ph === "Western-V low" ? PALETTE.phase.wnpLow : "#ffffff";
      }
      const ph = d.enso;
      return ph === "El Niño" ? PALETTE.phase.elnino : ph === "La Niña" ? PALETTE.phase.lanina : "#ffffff";
    };
    const stripPlot = Plot.plot({
      height: 38, width: W, marginLeft: 55, marginRight: isAbsMode ? 145 : 20, marginTop: 0, marginBottom: 28,
      x: {domain: yrDomain, axis: "bottom", tickFormat: (d) => String(d).slice(-2), label: null,
          ticks: data.map((d) => d.year).filter((y) => y % 5 === 0)},
      marks: [
        Plot.cell(data, {x: "year", fill: isDiscrete ? cellColors : (d) => stripCardColor(driverValueFor(s === "MAM" ? "Western-V (WNP)" : "ENSO (RONI)", s, d.year)),
          stroke: "#cbd5e1", strokeWidth: 0.5,
          channels: {Year: {value: (d) => String(d.year)}, Ocean: {value: (d) => s === "MAM" ? d.wnp : `${d.enso} · ${d.iodPhase}`}},
          tip: {format: {x: false, y: false, fill: false, Year: true, Ocean: true}}}),
      ],
    });
    stripEl = html`<div style="margin-top: -2px;">${stripPlot}</div>`;
  }

  return html`
    <div class="rain-panel" style="min-width: ${twoUp ? 420 : 860}px; flex: 1 1 ${twoUp ? 420 : 860}px;">
      <div style="font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; margin-bottom: 2px; color: #0f172a;">
        ${seasonWord(s)} (${s}) &bull; Climatological Normal (1991–2020): ${tMean} ${varDef.unit}
      </div>
      ${chipsBar}
      <div>${main}</div>
      ${stripEl}
    </div>
  `;
}
dbChirpsMonthly = DuckDBClient.of({
  chirps_monthly: FileAttachment("/data/KE-enso-explorer/chirps_county_monthly.parquet"),
})

rainMonthlyRaw = dbChirpsMonthly.query(`
  SELECT month,
         AVG(ptot) AS clim,
         STDDEV(ptot) AS sd,
         MIN(ptot) AS min_val,
         MAX(ptot) AS max_val
  FROM chirps_monthly
  WHERE ${normExpr("county")} = '${countyNorm(county)}'
    AND year BETWEEN 1991 AND 2020
  GROUP BY month
  ORDER BY month
`)

rainMonthlyClim = {
  const mNames = ["Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun", "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec"];
  return rainMonthlyRaw.map((r) => {
    const s = [3, 4, 5].includes(r.month) ? "MAM" : [10, 11, 12].includes(r.month) ? "OND" : "Other";
    return {...r, name: mNames[r.month - 1], season: s};
  });
}

rainMonthlyChart = {

  return Plot.plot({

// ---- Figure 3.2 Contingency Probability Matrix Machinery (ENSO-V3-042) ----
viewof contOndDriver = Inputs.radio(["ENSO (RONI)", "IOD (DMI)"], {
  value: "ENSO (RONI)",
  label: "OND Driver:"
})
viewof contMamDriver = Inputs.radio(["Western-V (WNP)", "ENSO (RONI)"], {
  value: "Western-V (WNP)",
  label: "MAM Driver:"
})
viewof contDetail = Inputs.radio(["Summary (3 groups)", "Detailed (5 groups)"], {
  value: "Summary (3 groups)",
  label: "Driver bins:"
})
viewof contShape = Inputs.radio(["Stacked shares (100%)", "Frequency counts (years)"], {
  value: "Stacked shares (100%)",
  label: "Plot representation:"
})
viewof contYearFrom = Inputs.number([1981, 2024], {value: 1981, step: 1, label: "From year:"})
viewof contYearTo = Inputs.number([1981, 2024], {value: 2024, step: 1, label: "To year:"})
contYears = [contYearFrom, contYearTo]
contRows = (season, drvName) => {
  const yrLo = Math.min(contYearFrom, contYearTo);
  const yrHi = Math.max(contYearFrom, contYearTo);
  const def = phaseDefs[drvName];
  if (!def) return {out: [], nAll: 0, groups: []};
  const is5 = contDetail.startsWith("Detailed");

  const rows = outlookBase.filter((r) =>
    r.season === season &&
    r.gaul1_code === selGaul &&
    r.year >= yrLo && r.year <= yrHi &&
    r.tercile != null
  );
  const nAll = rows.length;
  if (!nAll) return {out: [], nAll: 0, groups: []};

  const getZ = (y) => {
    if (drvName === "ENSO (RONI)") return (season === "MAM" ? roniZMam : roniZOnd).get(y);
    const m = zSeries(drvName, season);
    return m ? m.get(y) : null;
  };

  const classify = (z) => {
    if (z == null || Number.isNaN(z)) return null;
    if (is5) {
      if (z >= 1.5) return `Strong ${def.pos}`;
      if (z >= 0.5) return `Moderate ${def.pos}`;
      if (z > -0.5) return "Neutral";
      if (z > -1.5) return `Moderate ${def.neg}`;
      return `Strong ${def.neg}`;
    }
    if (z >= 0.5) return def.pos;
    if (z <= -0.5) return def.neg;
    return "Neutral";
  };

  const groups5 = [`Strong ${def.pos}`, `Moderate ${def.pos}`, "Neutral", `Moderate ${def.neg}`, `Strong ${def.neg}`];
  const groups3 = [def.pos, "Neutral", def.neg];
  const groups = is5 ? groups5 : groups3;

  const counts = new Map();
  for (const g of groups) counts.set(g, {Wetter: 0, "Near-normal": 0, Drier: 0, total: 0});

  for (const r of rows) {
    const z = getZ(r.year);
    const g = classify(z);
    if (!g || !counts.has(g)) continue;
    const bucket = counts.get(g);
    const oc = r.tercile === "Wet" ? "Wetter" : r.tercile === "Dry" ? "Drier" : "Near-normal";
    bucket[oc] = (bucket[oc] || 0) + 1;
    bucket.total = (bucket.total || 0) + 1;
  }

  const out = [];
  for (const g of groups) {
    const b = counts.get(g);
    const tot = b.total;
    for (const oc of ["Wetter", "Near-normal", "Drier"]) {
      const k = b[oc] || 0;
      out.push({
        season, driver: drvName, group: g, outcome: oc,
        count: k, total: tot,
        share: tot > 0 ? k / tot : null,
        pct: tot > 0 ? `${Math.round((k / tot) * 100)}%` : "—",
        small: tot < 5,
      });
    }
  }
  return {out, nAll, groups};
}

contingencyPanel = (season, drvName, opts = {}) => {
  const {out, nAll, groups} = contRows(season, drvName);
  if (!out.length) return html`<div style="color:#666">No record for ${county} (${season}).</div>`;
  const isShares = contShape.startsWith("Stacked");
  const outcomes = ["Wetter", "Near-normal", "Drier"];
  const outcomeColors = [PALETTE.outcome.wetter, PALETTE.outcome.near, PALETTE.outcome.drier];

  const yDomain = [...groups].reverse();
  const def = phaseDefs[drvName];

  return Plot.plot({
    height: Math.max(160, groups.length * 36 + 40),
    width: opts.width || 480,
    marginLeft: opts.marginLeft || 165,
    marginRight: opts.marginRight || 70,
    marginTop: 10,
    marginBottom: 35,
    x: isShares
      ? {
          domain: [0, 1],
          label: "Tercile share",
          ticks: [0, 0.333, 0.5, 0.667, 1],
          tickFormat: (d) => `${Math.round(d * 100)}%`
        }
      : {label: "Seasons (years)", nice: true},
    y: {domain: yDomain, label: null},
    color: {domain: outcomes, range: outcomeColors, legend: false},
    marks: [
      isShares ? Plot.ruleX([0.333], {stroke: "#334155", strokeDasharray: "3,3", strokeWidth: 1.2}) : null,
      isShares
        ? Plot.barX(out, {
            y: "group", x: "share", fill: "outcome", order: outcomes,
            channels: {
              Driver: "driver", Group: "group", Outcome: "outcome",
              Count: (d) => `${d.count} of ${d.total} yrs`,
              Share: (d) => d.pct,
              Advisory: (d) => d.small ? "Small sample (n < 5)" : "Sample OK"
            },
            tip: {format: {y: true, x: false, fill: false, Driver: true, Group: true, Outcome: true, Count: true, Share: true, Advisory: true}}
          })
        : Plot.barX(out, {
            y: "group", x: "count", fill: "outcome", order: outcomes,
            channels: {
              Driver: "driver", Group: "group", Outcome: "outcome",
              Count: (d) => `${d.count} yrs`,
              Share: (d) => d.pct,
              Advisory: (d) => d.small ? "Small sample (n < 5)" : "Sample OK"
            },
            tip: {format: {y: true, x: true, fill: false, Driver: true, Group: true, Outcome: true, Count: true, Share: true, Advisory: true}}
          }),
      Plot.text(
        out.filter((d) => d.outcome === "Wetter"),
        {
          y: "group",
          x: (d) => isShares ? 1 : d.total,
          textAnchor: "start",
          dx: 6,
          text: (d) => `n=${d.total}`,
          fill: (d) => d.small ? "#b45309" : "#64748b",
          fontSize: 11,
          fontWeight: (d) => d.small ? "700" : "400",
        }
      ),
    ].filter(Boolean)
  });
}

insightB2 = {
  const sel = activeSeason === "OND" ? contOndDriver : contMamDriver;
  const {out, nAll} = contRows(activeSeason, sel);
  if (!out.length) return html`<div style="color:#666">No historical records for ${county} (${activeSeason}).</div>`;
  const posName = phaseDefs[sel]?.pos ?? "positive";
  const posGroups = out.filter((d) => d.group.includes(posName));
  const n = d3.sum(posGroups, (d) => d.count);
  if (!n) {
    return html`<div class="figure-caption" style="margin-top:0.4rem; font-size: 0.82rem; color: #64748b;">
      Baseline record: <strong>${nAll} historical seasons</strong> across 1981–2024. No ${posName} seasons observed under current filtering.
    </div>`;
  }
  const cWet = d3.sum(posGroups.filter((d) => d.outcome === "Wetter"), (d) => d.count);
  const cNear = d3.sum(posGroups.filter((d) => d.outcome === "Near-normal"), (d) => d.count);
  const cDry = d3.sum(posGroups.filter((d) => d.outcome === "Drier"), (d) => d.count);
  
  let topOutcome = "Wetter";
  let cTop = cWet;
  if (cDry > cTop) { topOutcome = "Drier"; cTop = cDry; }
  if (cNear > cTop) { topOutcome = "Near-normal"; cTop = cNear; }
  
  const pct = Math.round((cTop / n) * 100);
  const sampleAdvisory = n < 5 ? html`<span style="margin-left: 6px; font-size: 0.74rem; background: #fffbeb; color: #b45309; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid #fef08a;">Small sample size (n = ${n} seasons)</span>` : "";

  return html`
    <div style="background: #f8fafc; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 6px; padding: 0.65rem 0.95rem; font-size: 0.82rem; line-height: 1.5; color: #334155;">
      <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; margin-bottom: 2px;">
        <strong style="color: #0f172a;">Empirical Teleconnection Frequency:</strong>
        ${sampleAdvisory}
      </div>
      During ${posName} conditions in the <strong>${seasonWord(activeSeason)} (${activeSeason})</strong>,
      <strong>${cTop} of ${n} seasons (${pct}%)</strong> resulted in <strong>${topOutcome}</strong> conditions relative to the 1991–2020 climatological normal.
    </div>
  `;
}

sec23CandidateDrivers = {
  const isMAM = sec23SeasonCode === "MAM";
  const driverList = isMAM
    ? [
        {name: "Western-V (WNP)", basin: "Western North Pacific", code: "WNP"},
        {name: "ENSO (RONI)", basin: "Equatorial Pacific", code: "RONI"},
        {name: "IOD (DMI)", basin: "Equatorial Indian Ocean", code: "DMI"},
      ]
    : [
        {name: "ENSO (RONI)", basin: "Equatorial Pacific", code: "RONI"},
        {name: "IOD (DMI)", basin: "Equatorial Indian Ocean", code: "DMI"},
        {name: "ENSO + IOD", basin: "Joint Equatorial (Pacific + Indian)", code: "JOINT"},
      ];

  const rows = await dbChirps.query(`
    SELECT year, value_mean AS val
    FROM chirps_county
    WHERE ${normExpr("admin1_name")} = '${countyNorm(county)}'
      AND variable = 'PTOT'
      AND period = '${sec23SeasonCode}'
      AND year BETWEEN 1981 AND 2024
    ORDER BY year
  `);

  const results = [];
  for (const drv of driverList) {
    const pairs = [];
    for (const r of rows) {
      const y = r.year;
      let dVal = null;
      if (drv.code === "RONI") {
        dVal = isMAM ? (roniRawMam.get(y) ?? rawSeasonMean("roni", "MAM", y)) : (roniRawOnd.get(y) ?? rawSeasonMean("roni", "OND", y));
      } else if (drv.code === "DMI") {
        dVal = rawSeasonMean("dmi_hadisst", sec23SeasonCode, y);
      } else if (drv.code === "WNP") {
        dVal = rawSeasonMean("wnp_std_mam", sec23SeasonCode, y);
      } else if (drv.code === "JOINT") {
        const e = (roniRawOnd.get(y) ?? rawSeasonMean("roni", "OND", y) ?? 0);
        const i = rawSeasonMean("dmi_hadisst", "OND", y) || 0;
        dVal = (e + i) / 2;
      }
      if (dVal != null && !Number.isNaN(dVal)) {
        pairs.push({x: dVal, y: r.val});
      }
    }
    const n = pairs.length;
    if (n < 5) {
      results.push({...drv, r: 0, r2: 0, p: 1, n, utility: "Insufficient data"});
      continue;
    }
    const mx = d3.mean(pairs, d => d.x), my = d3.mean(pairs, d => d.y);
    const cov = d3.sum(pairs, d => (d.x - mx) * (d.y - my));
    const varX = d3.sum(pairs, d => (d.x - mx) ** 2);
    const varY = d3.sum(pairs, d => (d.y - my) ** 2);
    const r = (varX > 0 && varY > 0) ? cov / Math.sqrt(varX * varY) : 0;
    const r2 = r * r;
    const tStat = Math.abs(r) < 1 ? r * Math.sqrt((n - 2) / (1 - r2)) : 99;
    const pVal = Math.abs(tStat) > 3.5 ? 0.001 : Math.abs(tStat) > 2.7 ? 0.01 : Math.abs(tStat) > 2.0 ? 0.05 : 0.2;

    let utility = "Weak Teleconnection (p > 0.05)";
    if (pVal <= 0.05) {
      if (Math.abs(r) >= 0.5) utility = "Primary Teleconnection Driver";
      else if (Math.abs(r) >= 0.3) utility = "Moderate Predictive Utility";
      else utility = "Marginal Teleconnection";
    }

    results.push({...drv, r, r2, p: pVal, n, utility});
  }

  results.sort((a, b) => Math.abs(b.r) - Math.abs(a.r));
  return results;
}

sec23DriverTableRender = {

        </div>
        <div style="font-size: 0.74rem; color: #64748b;">
          County: <strong>${county}</strong> &bull; Ranked by correlation
        </div>
      </div>
      <div style="overflow-x: auto;">
        <table class="plot-data-table" style="width: 100%; font-size: 0.82rem;">
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th>Ocean Driver</th>
              <th>Ocean Basin</th>
              <th>Correlation (r)</th>
              <th>Variance Explained (R²)</th>
              <th>Significance</th>
              <th>Decision Utility</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            ${data.map((d, i) => html`
              <tr style="${i === 0 ? 'background: #f0fdf4;' : ''}">
                <td>
                  <strong>${d.name}</strong>
                  ${i === 0 ? html`<span style="margin-left: 6px; font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 700; background: #bbf7d0; color: #166534; padding: 1px 6px; border-radius: 4px;">Top Driver</span>` : ''}
                </td>
                <td style="color: #64748b;">${d.basin}</td>
                <td>
                  <strong style="color: ${Math.abs(d.r) >= 0.4 ? (d.r > 0 ? '#0284c7' : '#d97706') : '#475569'};">
                    ${d.r >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${d.r.toFixed(2)}
                  </strong>
                </td>
                <td><strong>${Math.round(d.r2 * 100)}%</strong></td>
                <td>
                  <span style="font-weight: 600; color: ${d.p <= 0.05 ? '#166534' : '#b45309'};">
                    ${d.p <= 0.001 ? 'p < 0.001' : d.p <= 0.05 ? 'p ≤ 0.05' : 'p > 0.05'}
                  </span>
                </td>
                <td>
                  <span style="font-size: 0.78rem; padding: 2px 7px; border-radius: 4px; font-weight: 600; background: ${d.utility.includes('Primary') ? '#dcfce7' : d.utility.includes('Moderate') ? '#e0f2fe' : '#f1f5f9'}; color: ${d.utility.includes('Primary') ? '#15803d' : d.utility.includes('Moderate') ? '#0369a1' : '#64748b'};">
                    ${d.utility}
                  </span>
                </td>
              </tr>
            `)}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </div>
  `;
}

sec23Data = {

    let dVal = null;
    if (sec23Driver === "ENSO (RONI)") {
      dVal = sec23SeasonCode === "OND" ? (roniRawOnd.get(y) ?? rawSeasonMean("roni", "OND", y) ?? rawSeasonMean("nino34_anom_noaa", "OND", y)) : (roniRawMam.get(y) ?? rawSeasonMean("roni", "MAM", y) ?? rawSeasonMean("nino34_anom_noaa", "MAM", y));
    } else if (sec23Driver === "IOD (DMI)") {
      dVal = rawSeasonMean("dmi_hadisst", sec23SeasonCode, y);
    } else if (sec23Driver === "Western-V (WNP)") {
      dVal = rawSeasonMean("wnp_std_mam", sec23SeasonCode, y);
    } else if (sec23Driver === "ENSO + IOD") {
      const e = (sec23SeasonCode === "OND" ? roniRawOnd.get(y) : roniRawMam.get(y)) ?? rawSeasonMean("roni", sec23SeasonCode, y) ?? rawSeasonMean("nino34_anom_noaa", sec23SeasonCode, y) ?? 0;
      const i = rawSeasonMean("dmi_hadisst", "OND", y) || 0;
      dVal = (e + i) / 2;
    }

    if (dVal == null || Number.isNaN(dVal)) continue;

    let yVal;
    if (sec23Metric === "Total Rainfall (mm)") {
      yVal = r.val;
    } else if (sec23Metric === "Rainfall Anomaly (%)") {
      yVal = climMean > 0 ? ((r.val - climMean) / climMean) * 100 : 0;
    } else {
      yVal = r.val;
    }

    joined.push({
      year: y,
      x: dVal,
      y: yVal
    });
  }

  // Calculate tercile classifications for county rainfall response
  const yVals = joined.map(d => d.y).sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const q33 = d3.quantile(yVals, 0.333);
  const q67 = d3.quantile(yVals, 0.667);

  joined.forEach(d => {
    d.outcome = d.y >= q67 ? "Wetter" : (d.y <= q33 ? "Drier" : "Near-normal");
    d.color = d.outcome === "Wetter" ? "#2b83ba" : (d.outcome === "Drier" ? "#d7191c" : "#94a3b8");
  });

  // Identify notable benchmark years to label by default (top 3 wettest, top 3 driest, top 2 strongest driver departures)
  const sortedByY = [...joined].sort((a, b) => b.y - a.y);
  const sortedByAbsX = [...joined].sort((a, b) => Math.abs(b.x) - Math.abs(a.x));
  const benchmarkYears = new Set([
    ...sortedByY.slice(0, 3).map(d => d.year),
    ...sortedByY.slice(-3).map(d => d.year),
    ...sortedByAbsX.slice(0, 2).map(d => d.year)
  ]);

  joined.forEach(d => {
    d.isBenchmark = benchmarkYears.has(d.year);
  });

  // Calculate Pearson r, R², and OLS regression
  const n = joined.length;
  if (n < 3) return {points: [], r: 0, r2: 0, slope: 0, intercept: 0, pVal: 1, trendLine: []};

  const mx = d3.mean(joined, d => d.x);
  const my = d3.mean(joined, d => d.y);
  const cov = d3.sum(joined, d => (d.x - mx) * (d.y - my));
  const varX = d3.sum(joined, d => (d.x - mx) ** 2);
  const varY = d3.sum(joined, d => (d.y - my) ** 2);

  const r = (varX > 0 && varY > 0) ? cov / Math.sqrt(varX * varY) : 0;
  const r2 = r * r;
  const slope = varX > 0 ? cov / varX : 0;
  const intercept = my - slope * mx;

  const tStat = Math.abs(r) < 1 ? r * Math.sqrt((n - 2) / (1 - r2)) : 99;
  const pVal = Math.abs(tStat) > 3.5 ? 0.001 : Math.abs(tStat) > 2.7 ? 0.01 : Math.abs(tStat) > 2.0 ? 0.05 : 0.2;

  const xExtent = d3.extent(joined, d => d.x);
  const trendLine = [
    {x: xExtent[0], y: slope * xExtent[0] + intercept},
    {x: xExtent[1], y: slope * xExtent[1] + intercept}
  ];

  return {points: joined, r, r2, slope, intercept, pVal, trendLine, n};
}

table21Stats = {
  const chirpsRows = await dbChirps.query(`
    SELECT period,
           MIN(value_mean) AS min_val,
           MAX(value_mean) AS max_val,
           MEDIAN(value_mean) AS med_val,
           AVG(CASE WHEN year BETWEEN 1991 AND 2020 THEN value_mean END) AS clim
    FROM chirps_county
    WHERE ${normExpr("admin1_name")} = '${countyNorm(county)}'
      AND variable = 'PTOT' AND period IN ('OND', 'MAM')
    GROUP BY period
  `);
  const ondStat = chirpsRows.find((r) => r.period === "OND") || {min_val: 0, max_val: 0, med_val: 0, clim: 0};
  const mamStat = chirpsRows.find((r) => r.period === "MAM") || {min_val: 0, max_val: 0, med_val: 0, clim: 0};

  const peakRows = await dbChirps.query(`
    WITH base AS (
      SELECT period, year, value_mean,
             value_mean - AVG(CASE WHEN year BETWEEN 1991 AND 2020 THEN value_mean END) OVER (PARTITION BY period) AS anom
      FROM chirps_county
      WHERE ${normExpr("admin1_name")} = '${countyNorm(county)}'
        AND variable = 'PTOT' AND period IN ('OND', 'MAM')
    )
    SELECT period, year, value_mean, anom
    FROM base
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY period ORDER BY anom DESC) = 1
  `);
  const ondPeak = peakRows.find((r) => r.period === "OND") || {year: "—", anom: 0};
  const mamPeak = peakRows.find((r) => r.period === "MAM") || {year: "—", anom: 0};

  const floodRows = await dbExposure.query(`
    SELECT rp,
           SUM(flood_prone_km2) AS flood_km2,
           SUM(pop_exposed) AS pop_exp,
           AVG(pop_pct) AS avg_pct,
           STRING_AGG(adm2_name || ' (' || CAST(ROUND(pop_exposed) AS INT) || ' people)', ', ') AS subcounties
    FROM exp_jrc
    WHERE ${normExpr("adm1_name")} = '${countyNorm(county)}' AND rp = 100
    GROUP BY rp
  `);
  const floodStat = floodRows[0] || {flood_km2: 0, pop_exp: 0, avg_pct: 0, subcounties: "None recorded"};

  return {ondStat, mamStat, ondPeak, mamPeak, floodStat};
}

dbGesi = DuckDBClient.of({
  gesi: FileAttachment("/data/KE-enso-explorer/gesi_v2.parquet"),
})
// Served (gated) GESI series from the KNBS County Gender Data Sheets. Keyed by
// the sheet's stable indicator CODE; only series whose Kenya national value is
// consistent across all 47 sheets survived the gate (that consistency is the
// LLM-independent quality proof). See _sources/gesi_extract.py.
gesiAll = dbGesi.query(`SELECT code, sub, label, county, kenya, county_value AS v FROM gesi`)
// per indicator: the full 47-county distribution (for the strip), the selected
// county's value + rank, Kenya (national) marker, median. Positions normalised
// to each indicator's own 47-county range (mixed units → position, not value).
gesiSeries = {
  const clamp01 = (x) => Math.max(0, Math.min(1, x));
  const norm = countyNorm(county);
  const byInd = d3.group(gesiAll, (d) => d.code + "|" + (d.sub ?? ""));
  const out = [];
  for (const [key, recs] of byInd) {
    const vals = recs.map((r) => r.v).filter((x) => x != null);
    if (vals.length < 20) continue;
    const min = d3.min(vals), max = d3.max(vals), span = (max - min) || 1;
    const median = d3.median(vals);
    const cRec = recs.find((r) => countyNorm(r.county) === norm);
    const r0 = recs[0];
    const label = r0.label + (r0.sub ? ` — ${r0.sub}` : "");
    const dots = recs.filter((r) => r.v != null).map((r) => ({
      county: r.county, v: r.v, pos: clamp01((r.v - min) / span),
      sel: countyNorm(r.county) === norm}));
    out.push({code: r0.code, sub: r0.sub, indicator: label, kenya: r0.kenya, n: vals.length,
      min, max, median, cv: cRec ? cRec.v : null,
      rank: cRec ? vals.filter((x) => x > cRec.v).length + 1 : null,
      posK: clamp01((r0.kenya - min) / span), posMed: clamp01((median - min) / span), dots});
  }
  return out.sort((a, b) => a.code.localeCompare(b.code) || (a.sub || "").localeCompare(b.sub || ""));
}
// flat export for the download button
gesiExport = gesiSeries.map((s) => ({indicator: s.indicator, code: s.code, sub: s.sub,
  county: s.cv, kenya: s.kenya, rank: s.rank, n: s.n, min: s.min, median: s.median, max: s.max}))
// Mount Figure 1.3 plotFooter into fig13FooterHost
{
  [county, gesiExport, gesiSeries];
  const host = document.getElementById("fig13FooterHost");
  const chartEl = document.getElementById("gesi-plot-canvas") || document.getElementById("section-gesi") || host;
  if (host && chartEl && gesiExport) {
    const footer = plotFooter(
      `Socio-economic and gender vulnerability profile for ${county} benchmarked against Kenya national averages across 35 indicators (KNBS 2019 Census & 2023 Gender Data Sheets).`,
      chartEl,
      {
        fig: "1.3",
        filename: `${county}_socioeconomic_gender_vulnerability_knbs`,
        data: gesiExport,
        svgOverride: typeof window.buildGesiSvg === "function" ? window.buildGesiSvg : null,
        about: `Audited statutory indicators from the Kenya National Bureau of Statistics (KNBS) 2019 Census Volume IV and 2023 County Gender Data Sheets. Compares ${county} against the Kenya national average benchmark and establishes statutory county rank (1 to 47).`,
        meta: {
          Source: "KNBS 2019 Census & 2023 County Gender Data Sheets",
          County: county
        },
        columns: [
          { key: "indicator", label: "Indicator" },
          { key: "code", label: "Statutory Code" },
          { key: "county", label: `${county} Value`, fmt: v => v != null ? (typeof v === "number" ? v.toLocaleString() : v) : "—" },
          { key: "kenya", label: "National Benchmark", fmt: v => v != null ? (typeof v === "number" ? v.toLocaleString() : v) : "—" },
          { key: "rank", label: "Rank (1 to 47)", fmt: v => v != null ? `${v}/47` : "—" }
        ],
        showTable: false
      }
    );
    host.replaceChildren(footer);
  }
}

// fatalities is INT64 (SUM would return HUGEINT -> BigInt in JS);

         CAST(SUM(fatalities) AS INT) AS fatalities
  FROM acled_conflict

dbPrices = DuckDBClient.of({
  market_prices: FileAttachment("/data/KE-enso-explorer/market_prices.parquet"),
})

// Retail only: each product has exactly ONE unit in the retail series
// (verified 2026-07-15 — the 90_kg maize rows are all Wholesale), so a
// single y axis per product is honest. Product options are scoped to
// the selected county so the select never offers an empty chart.
priceProducts = {
  const rows = await dbPrices.query(`
    SELECT DISTINCT product
    FROM market_prices
    WHERE ${normExpr("county")} = '${countyNorm(county)}'
      AND price_type = 'Retail'
    ORDER BY product`);
  return rows.map((d) => d.product);
}

viewof priceProduct = Inputs.select(
  priceProducts.length ? priceProducts : ["(no data)"],
  {
    label: "Retail Item:",
    value: priceProducts.includes("Maize Grain (White)") ? "Maize Grain (White)" : (priceProducts[0] || "(no data)")
  }
)

// product names contain apostrophes (Cow's Milk ...) — escape for SQL
pricesCty = dbPrices.query(`
  SELECT market, period_date, CAST(year AS INT) AS year, CAST(month AS INT) AS month, value_kes, unit
  FROM market_prices
  WHERE ${normExpr("county")} = '${countyNorm(county)}'
    AND price_type = 'Retail'
    AND product = '${String(priceProduct || "Maize Grain (White)").replace(/'/g, "''")}'
  ORDER BY period_date`)

priceUnitLabel = pricesCty.length ? `KES per ${pricesCty[0].unit.replace("_", " ")}` : "KES"

// Presentation transform toggle: transforms the already-loaded series client-side
viewof priceView = Inputs.radio(["Change vs year earlier", "Seasonal anomaly", "Raw price"], {
  label: "Price View:",
  value: "Change vs year earlier",
})

viewof priceMarkets = {
  const mkts = [...new Set(pricesCty.map((d) => d.market))].sort();
  const input = Inputs.select(mkts.length ? mkts : ["(no data)"], {
    label: "Markets:",
    multiple: true,
    value: mkts,
  });
  if (typeof enhancedMultiSelect === "function" && mkts.length) {
    enhancedMultiSelect(input, {
      requireAtLeastOne: true,
      enableSelectAll: true,
      searchable: mkts.length > 5,
      compactLabelThreshold: 4
    });
  }
  return input;
}

viewof priceAgg = Inputs.radio(["Monthly lines", "Quarterly bars", "Yearly bars"], {
  label: "Aggregation:",
  value: "Monthly lines",
})

// Gap-segmented series filtered by chosen markets
pricesSeg = {
  const GAP_DAYS = 100; // > ~3 months apart => new segment
  const sel = new Set(priceMarkets || []);
  const filtered = pricesCty.filter((d) => sel.size === 0 || sel.has(d.market));
  const byMkt = d3.group(filtered, (d) => d.market);
  const out = [];
  for (const [mkt, rows] of byMkt) {
    const sorted = rows
      .map((d) => ({...d, _t: new Date(d.period_date)}))
      .sort((a, b) => a._t - b._t);
    let seg = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < sorted.length; i++) {
      if (i > 0 && (sorted[i]._t - sorted[i - 1]._t) / 86400000 > GAP_DAYS) seg++;
      out.push({...sorted[i], seg: `${mkt}__${seg}`});
    }
  }
  return out;
}

// Client-side statistical transforms for price series
pricesView = {
  if (!pricesSeg.length) return {rows: [], label: priceUnitLabel, ref: null};
  if (priceView === "Raw price") {
    return {rows: pricesSeg.map((d) => ({...d, v: d.value_kes})), label: priceUnitLabel, ref: null};
  }
  if (priceView === "Change vs year earlier") {
    const byMkt = d3.group(pricesSeg, (d) => d.market);
    const out = [];
    for (const [, rows] of byMkt) {
      const byKey = new Map(rows.map((d) => [`${d.year}-${d.month}`, d.value_kes]));
      for (const d of rows) {
        const prev = byKey.get(`${d.year - 1}-${d.month}`);
        if (prev != null && prev > 0) {
          out.push({...d, v: (d.value_kes / prev - 1) * 100});
        }
      }
    }
    return {rows: out, label: "% change vs same month a year earlier", ref: 0};
  }
  // Seasonal anomaly: z-score vs that market's month-of-year climatology
  const byMkt = d3.group(pricesSeg, (d) => d.market);
  const out = [];
  for (const [, rows] of byMkt) {
    const clim = d3.rollup(
      rows,
      (v) => ({m: d3.mean(v, (d) => d.value_kes), s: d3.deviation(v, (d) => d.value_kes)}),
      (d) => d.month
    );
    for (const d of rows) {
      const c = clim.get(d.month);
      if (c && c.s > 0) {
        out.push({...d, v: (d.value_kes - c.m) / c.s});
      }
    }
  }
  return {rows: out, label: "Seasonal anomaly (standard deviations vs monthly climatology)", ref: 0};
}
dbRw = DuckDBClient.of({

// deterministic single-category classification (first match wins) so a
// multi-tagged report is counted exactly once in the stacked bars
rwCat = (t) => {
  const s = t ?? "";
  return s.includes("Drought") ? "Drought"
    : s.includes("Flood") ? "Flood"
    : s.includes("Epidemic") ? "Epidemic"
    : "Other";
}

rwByYear = d3.rollups(rwCty, (v) => v.length, (d) => +d.date.slice(0, 4), (d) => rwCat(d.disaster_type))
  .flatMap(([year, cats]) => cats.map(([cat, n]) => ({year, cat, n})))

// dekadal NDVI as % of the long-term normal (WFP VAM / MODIS, pixel-
