      posLabel: "High W-V (+σ)",
      negLabel: "Low W-V (-σ)",
      neuLabel: "Neutral",
      posCrit: "≥ +0.5 σ",
      negCrit: "≤ -0.5 σ",
      neuCrit: "-0.5 to +0.5 σ",
      isPos: (v) => v >= 0.5,
      isNeg: (v) => v <= -0.5,
      posColor: "#0284c7",
      neuColor: "#64748b",
      negColor: "#dc2626"
    };
  }
}
// Figure 4.2: Empirical Phase Response Chart (Dot + Range Interval Plot)
sec31bChart = {
  const meta = sec31bMeta;
  const items = sec31Items || [];
  const isCrops = sec31Group === "Crops";

  if (!sec31ProdRows.length || !items.length) {
    return html`<div style="padding: 2rem; text-align: center; color: #64748b; background: #f8fafc; border-radius: 8px;">
      No production records available for empirical phase response.
    </div>`;
  }

  // Visual Legend Key explaining what each dot and line represents
  const legendKey = html`
    <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1.25rem; font-size: 0.78rem; color: #475569; background: #f8fafc; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; padding: 0.5rem 0.85rem; border-radius: 6px; margin-bottom: 0.85rem; flex-wrap: wrap;">
      <span style="font-weight: 700; color: #0f172a;">Chart Legend:</span>
      <span style="display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;">
        <span style="width: 14px; height: 14px; border-radius: 50%; background: #0f172a; border: 2.5px solid #2563eb; display: inline-block;"></span>
        <strong>Empirical Phase Mean</strong> (average across all surveyed years in this phase)
      </span>
      <span style="display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;">
        <span style="width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%; background: #2563eb; border: 1.5px solid #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #94a3b8; display: inline-block;"></span>
        <span>Individual Surveyed Year (single KNBS record)</span>
      </span>
      <span style="display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;">
        <span style="width: 20px; height: 4px; background: #2563eb; opacity: 0.65; border-radius: 2px; display: inline-block;"></span>
        <span>Observed Min–Max Production Range</span>
      </span>
    </div>
  `;

  // Build empirical phase summaries for each selected commodity
  const itemCards = items.map((itm) => {
    const rows = sec31ProdRows.filter((d) => d.item === itm && d.val > 0);
    const unitStr = rows[0]?.unit || (isCrops ? "t" : "head");

    const phaseRecords = rows.map((d) => {
      const bimo = sec31Bimodal.find((b) => b.year === d.year);
      const driverVal = bimo ? bimo[meta.key] : null;
      const rainVal = bimo ? bimo[meta.rainKey] : null;
      let phase = meta.neuLabel;
      if (driverVal != null) {
        if (meta.isPos(driverVal)) phase = meta.posLabel;
        else if (meta.isNeg(driverVal)) phase = meta.negLabel;
      }
      return { ...d, driverVal, rainVal, phase };
    });

    const phases = [
      { label: meta.posLabel, crit: meta.posCrit, color: meta.posColor },
      { label: meta.neuLabel, crit: meta.neuCrit, color: meta.neuColor },
      { label: meta.negLabel, crit: meta.negCrit, color: meta.negColor }
    ];

    const phaseStats = phases.map((p) => {
      const pRows = phaseRecords.filter((r) => r.phase === p.label);
      const count = pRows.length;
      const meanVal = count ? d3.mean(pRows, (r) => r.val) : null;
      const medVal = count ? d3.median(pRows, (r) => r.val) : null;
      const minVal = count ? d3.min(pRows, (r) => r.val) : null;
      const maxVal = count ? d3.max(pRows, (r) => r.val) : null;
      const meanRain = count ? d3.mean(pRows, (r) => r.rainVal) : null;
      const years = pRows.map((r) => r.year).sort().join(", ");
      return {
        phase: p.label,
        crit: p.crit,
        color: p.color,
        count,
        meanVal,
        medVal,
        minVal,
        maxVal,
        meanRain,
        years: years || "None observed"
      };
    });

    const maxObs = d3.max(phaseRecords, (d) => d.val) || 100;
    const xMax = maxObs * 1.35;

    // Dot + Interval Plot
    const pDotInterval = Plot.plot({
      width: 880,
      height: 195,
      marginLeft: 155,
      marginRight: 95,
      marginBottom: 35,
      x: {
        label: `${itm} Output (${unitStr}) [Interval: Min–Max Range • Dot: Empirical Mean • Markers: Surveyed Years]`,
        domain: [0, xMax],
        grid: true,
        nice: true,
        tickFormat: (v) => formatNumCompactShort()(v)
      },
      y: { domain: [meta.posLabel, meta.neuLabel, meta.negLabel], label: null },
      marks: [
        Plot.ruleX([0], {stroke: "#334155", strokeWidth: 1.2}),
        // Observed Range Interval line
        Plot.link(phaseStats.filter((d) => d.count > 0 && d.minVal != null), {
          y: "phase",
          x1: "minVal",
          x2: "maxVal",
          stroke: "color",
          strokeWidth: 4,
          strokeOpacity: 0.65
        }),
        // Individual surveyed years
        Plot.dot(phaseRecords, {
          y: "phase",
          x: "val",
          fill: (d) => {
            const p = phases.find((x) => x.label === d.phase);
            return p ? p.color : "#64748b";
          },
          stroke: "#ffffff",
          strokeWidth: 1.5,
          r: 5,
          channels: {
            Symbol: () => "Single-Year Surveyed Output",
            Commodity: "item",
            Year: (d) => String(d.year),
            Phase: "phase",
            "Recorded Output": (d) => `${formatNumCompactShort()(d.val)} ${d.unit || unitStr}`
          },
          tip: {format: {fill: false, Symbol: true, Commodity: true, Year: true, Phase: true, "Recorded Output": true}}
        }),
        // Mean Dot
        Plot.dot(phaseStats.filter((d) => d.count > 0 && d.meanVal != null), {
          y: "phase",
          x: "meanVal",
          fill: "#0f172a",
          stroke: "color",
          strokeWidth: 2.5,
          r: 7.5,
          channels: {
            Symbol: () => "Empirical Phase Mean (Multi-Year Average)",
            Phase: "phase",
            Criterion: "crit",
            "Empirical Mean": (d) => `${formatNumCompactShort()(d.meanVal)} ${unitStr}`,
            "Observed Range": (d) => `${formatNumCompactShort()(d.minVal)} – ${formatNumCompactShort()(d.maxVal)} ${unitStr}`,
            "Sample Size": (d) => `${d.count} years (${d.years})`
          },
          tip: {format: {fill: false, Symbol: true, Phase: true, Criterion: true, "Empirical Mean": true, "Observed Range": true, "Sample Size": true}}
        }),
        // Annotation text
        Plot.text(phaseStats.filter((d) => d.count > 0), {
          y: "phase",
          x: (d) => d.maxVal || d.meanVal,
          text: (d) => `  Phase Mean: ${formatNumCompactShort()(d.meanVal)} ${unitStr} (n=${d.count}: ${d.years})`,
          dx: 8,
          textAnchor: "start",
          fontSize: 9.5,
          fontWeight: 700,
          fill: "#1e293b"
        })
      ]
    });

    return html`
      <div style="background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 8px; padding: 1rem 1.25rem; margin-bottom: 1.25rem;">
        <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; margin-bottom: 0.85rem; border-bottom: 1px solid #f1f5f9; padding-bottom: 0.5rem;">
          <h4 style="margin: 0; font-size: 1.05rem; font-weight: 800; color: #0f172a;">
            ${itm} <span style="font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 500; color: #64748b;">(Unit: ${unitStr} &bull; KNBS Audited)</span>
          </h4>
          <span style="font-size: 0.76rem; color: #475569; font-weight: 600;">
            Conditioned on ${meta.name} (${meta.season})
          </span>
        </div>
        ${pDotInterval}
      </div>
    `;
  });

  return html`
    <div style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.5rem;">
      ${legendKey}
      ${itemCards}
    </div>
  `;
}
// Table 4.2: Empirical Ocean Driver Phase Summary Table
sec31bTable = {
  const meta = sec31bMeta;
  const items = sec31Items || [];
  const isCrops = sec31Group === "Crops";

  if (!sec31ProdRows.length || !items.length) {
    return html`<div style="padding: 1.5rem; color: #64748b;">No data available for Table 4.2.</div>`;
  }

  const tableRows = [];
  const phases = [
    { label: meta.posLabel, crit: meta.posCrit, color: meta.posColor, bg: "#f0f9ff" },
    { label: meta.neuLabel, crit: meta.neuCrit, color: meta.neuColor, bg: "#f8fafc" },
    { label: meta.negLabel, crit: meta.negCrit, color: meta.negColor, bg: "#fef2f2" }
  ];

  for (const itm of items) {
    const rows = sec31ProdRows.filter((d) => d.item === itm && d.val > 0);
    const unitStr = rows[0]?.unit || (isCrops ? "t" : "head");

    const phaseRecords = rows.map((d) => {
      const bimo = sec31Bimodal.find((b) => b.year === d.year);
      const driverVal = bimo ? bimo[meta.key] : null;
      const rainVal = bimo ? bimo[meta.rainKey] : null;
      let phase = meta.neuLabel;
      if (driverVal != null) {
        if (meta.isPos(driverVal)) phase = meta.posLabel;
        else if (meta.isNeg(driverVal)) phase = meta.negLabel;
      }
      return { ...d, driverVal, rainVal, phase };
    });

    for (const p of phases) {
      const pRows = phaseRecords.filter((r) => r.phase === p.label);
      const count = pRows.length;
      const meanVal = count ? d3.mean(pRows, (r) => r.val) : null;
      const medVal = count ? d3.median(pRows, (r) => r.val) : null;
      const minVal = count ? d3.min(pRows, (r) => r.val) : null;
      const maxVal = count ? d3.max(pRows, (r) => r.val) : null;
      const meanRain = count ? d3.mean(pRows, (r) => r.rainVal) : null;
      const years = pRows.map((r) => r.year).sort().join(", ");

      tableRows.push(html`
        <tr style="border-bottom: 1px solid #f1f5f9;">
          <td style="padding: 8px 10px; font-weight: 700; color: ${p.color};">
            ${p.label}
          </td>
          <td style="padding: 8px 10px; font-size: 0.78rem; color: #475569; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;">
            ${p.crit}
          </td>
          <td style="padding: 8px 10px; font-size: 0.78rem; color: #334155;">
            <strong>${count} yrs</strong> ${count ? `(${years})` : ""}
          </td>
          <td style="padding: 8px 10px; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 600; color: ${meanRain != null && meanRain >= 0 ? '#0369a1' : '#b91c1c'};">
            ${meanRain != null ? `${meanRain >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${Math.round(meanRain)}%` : "—"}
          </td>
          <td style="padding: 8px 10px; font-weight: 700; color: #0f172a;">
            ${itm}
          </td>
          <td style="padding: 8px 10px; font-weight: 800; color: #0f172a; text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;">
            ${meanVal != null ? `${formatNumCompactShort()(meanVal)} ${unitStr}` : "—"}
          </td>
          <td style="padding: 8px 10px; color: #475569; text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;">
            ${medVal != null ? `${formatNumCompactShort()(medVal)} ${unitStr}` : "—"}
          </td>
          <td style="padding: 8px 10px; color: #64748b; text-align: right; font-size: 0.76rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;">
            ${minVal != null && maxVal != null ? `${formatNumCompactShort()(minVal)} – ${formatNumCompactShort()(maxVal)} ${unitStr}` : "—"}
          </td>
        </tr>
      `);
    }
  }

  return html`
    <table style="width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 0.82rem; font-family: inherit;">
      <thead>
        <tr style="background: #f8fafc; border-bottom: 2px solid #e2e8f0; color: #475569; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.03em; font-size: 0.74rem;">
          <th style="padding: 8px 10px; text-align: left;">Driver Phase</th>
          <th style="padding: 8px 10px; text-align: left;">Numerical Threshold</th>
          <th style="padding: 8px 10px; text-align: left;">Sampled Years</th>
          <th style="padding: 8px 10px; text-align: left;">Mean Rain Anom</th>
          <th style="padding: 8px 10px; text-align: left;">Commodity</th>
          <th style="padding: 8px 10px; text-align: right;">Mean Output</th>
          <th style="padding: 8px 10px; text-align: right;">Median Output</th>
          <th style="padding: 8px 10px; text-align: right;">Observed Range</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        ${tableRows}
      </tbody>
    </table>
  `;
}

sec32NdviChart = {

  const rows = ndviCty.map((d) => ({...d, t: new Date(d.date)}));
  
  const epochs = [
    {from: new Date("2005-09-01"), to: new Date("2006-03-31"), label: "'06 Drought"},
    {from: new Date("2010-09-01"), to: new Date("2011-09-30"), label: "'11 Famine"},
    {from: new Date("2016-09-01"), to: new Date("2017-06-30"), label: "'17 Crisis"},
    {from: new Date("2020-09-01"), to: new Date("2023-01-31"), label: "'20–22 Triple Dip"},
    {from: new Date("2023-10-01"), to: new Date("2024-05-31"), label: "'23–24 El Niño Flush"}
  ];

  return Plot.plot({
    width: 880,
    height: 320,
    marginLeft: 60,

    x: {type: "utc", label: "Year", grid: true},

      label: "MODIS NDVI (% of Normal)",
      domain: [40, 160],
      grid: true,

    },
    marks: [

      }),
      Plot.text(epochs, {
        x: (d) => new Date((d.from.getTime() + d.to.getTime()) / 2),
        y: () => 152,
        text: "label",
        fontSize: 10,
        fontWeight: 700,
        fill: (d) => d.label.includes("Flush") ? "#0369a1" : "#b91c1c"
      }),
      Plot.ruleY([100], {stroke: "#475569", strokeWidth: 1.5, strokeDasharray: "3,3"}),
      Plot.areaY(rows, {
        x: "t",
        y1: (d) => Math.min(100, d.ndvi_pct_normal),
        y2: () => 100,
        fill: "#dc2626",
        fillOpacity: 0.35
      }),
      Plot.areaY(rows, {
        x: "t",
        y1: () => 100,
        y2: (d) => Math.max(100, d.ndvi_pct_normal),
        fill: "#16a34a",
        fillOpacity: 0.35
      }),
      Plot.lineY(rows, {
        x: "t",
        y: "ndvi_pct_normal",
        stroke: "#0f766e",
        strokeWidth: 1.1
      }),
      Plot.dot(rows, {
        x: "t",
        y: "ndvi_pct_normal",
        r: 1.5,
        fill: "transparent",
        channels: {
          Dekad: (d) => d.date,
          "NDVI % of Normal": (d) => `${d.ndvi_pct_normal.toFixed(1)}%`,
          Status: (d) => d.ndvi_pct_normal >= 100 ? "Surplus / Flush" : "Deficit / Stress"
        },
        tip: {format: {x: false, y: false, fill: false, Dekad: true, "NDVI % of Normal": true, Status: true}}
      })
    ]
  });
}

{
  [viewof priceProduct, viewof priceView, viewof priceAgg, viewof priceMarkets];
  const host = document.getElementById("sec32ControlsHost");
  if (host) {
    host.replaceChildren(
      html`<div style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.65rem; background: #f8fafc; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;">
        <div style="display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 1rem 1.4rem; align-items: flex-end;">
          <div style="min-width: 220px; flex: 1;">${viewof priceProduct}</div>
          <div style="min-width: 270px;">${viewof priceView}</div>
          <div style="min-width: 210px;">${viewof priceAgg}</div>
        </div>
        <div style="display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 1rem 1.4rem; align-items: center;">
          <div style="flex: 1; min-width: 260px;">${viewof priceMarkets}</div>
          <div style="font-size: 0.78rem; color: #64748b; line-height: 1.35; max-width: 420px;">
            FEWS NET Data Warehouse sentinel retail markets. ToT derived from goat (ea) &amp; maize (kg) series.
          </div>
        </div>

totRows = {
  const rows = await dbPrices.query(`
    WITH g AS (
      SELECT year, month, MEDIAN(value_kes) AS goat
      FROM market_prices
      WHERE ${normExpr("county")} = '${countyNorm(county)}'
        AND price_type = 'Retail' AND product = 'Goats (Local Quality)' AND unit = 'ea'
      GROUP BY year, month),
    m AS (
      SELECT year, month, MEDIAN(value_kes) AS maize
      FROM market_prices
      WHERE ${normExpr("county")} = '${countyNorm(county)}'
        AND price_type = 'Retail' AND product = 'Maize Grain (White)' AND unit = 'kg'
      GROUP BY year, month)
    SELECT g.year, g.month, g.goat, m.maize
    FROM g JOIN m ON g.year = m.year AND g.month = m.month
    WHERE m.maize > 0
    ORDER BY g.year, g.month`);
  const out = rows.map((d) => ({
    year: Number(d.year), month: Number(d.month),
    t: new Date(Date.UTC(Number(d.year), Number(d.month) - 1, 1)),
    goat: d.goat, maize: d.maize,
    tot: d.goat / d.maize
  }));
  let seg = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < out.length; i++) {
    if (i > 0 && (out[i].t - out[i - 1].t) / 86400000 > 100) seg++;
    out[i].seg = seg;
  }
  return out;
}

// Figure 3.2b Chart Generator (Prices & Terms of Trade)
sec32PricesChart = {
  const {rows, label, ref} = pricesView;
  if (!rows || !rows.length) {
    return noDataPlaceholder(`No retail market price records for ${priceProduct} in ${county} matching the active filters.`);
  }

  // Panel A: Retail Prices
  let pPrices;
  if (priceAgg !== "Monthly lines") {
    // Summary bars: mean of the selected transform across the chosen markets, per quarter or year
    const to = d3.max(rows, (d) => d._t);
    const bucket = (d) => priceAgg === "Yearly bars"
      ? Date.UTC(d._t.getUTCFullYear(), 0, 1)
      : Date.UTC(d._t.getUTCFullYear(), Math.floor(d._t.getUTCMonth() / 3) * 3, 1);
    const step = priceAgg === "Yearly bars" ? [1, 0] : [0, 3];
    const dataEnd = new Date(Date.UTC(to.getUTCFullYear(), to.getUTCMonth() + 1, 1));
    const agg = [...d3.rollup(rows, (v) => ({v: d3.mean(v, (d) => d.v), n: v.length}), bucket)]
      .map(([t0, o]) => {
        const d0 = new Date(t0);
        const xEnd = new Date(Date.UTC(d0.getUTCFullYear() + step[0], d0.getUTCMonth() + step[1], 1));
        return {
          x1: d0,
          x2: xEnd > dataEnd ? dataEnd : xEnd,
          partial: xEnd > dataEnd,
          v: o.v,
          n: o.n
        };
      }).sort((a, b) => a.x1 - b.x1);

    const aggLabel = `${label} (${priceAgg === "Yearly bars" ? "annual" : "quarterly"} mean)`;
    pPrices = Plot.plot({
      width: 880,
      height: 220,
      marginLeft: 65,
      marginRight: 130,
      x: {type: "utc", label: null, grid: true},
      y: {
        label: aggLabel,
        grid: true,
        tickFormat: (d) => ref == null ? formatNumCompactShort()(d) : (priceView.includes("Change") ? `${d > 0 ? "+" : ""}${d}%` : `${d.toFixed(1)}σ`)
      },
      marks: [
        Plot.rect(agg, {
          x1: "x1", x2: "x2", y1: () => 0, y2: "v", inset: 1,
          fill: (d) => (ref != null && d.v < 0 ? "#16a34a" : "#2563eb"),
          fillOpacity: (d) => d.partial ? 0.55 : 0.85,
          stroke: (d) => (ref != null && d.v < 0 ? "#15803d" : "#1d4ed8"),
          strokeWidth: 0.5,
          tip: true,
          title: (d) => {
            const period = priceAgg === "Yearly bars" ? d.x1.getUTCFullYear() : `${d.x1.getUTCFullYear()} Q${Math.floor(d.x1.getUTCMonth()/3) + 1}`;
            const val = ref == null ? `${Math.round(d.v).toLocaleString()} KES` : (priceView.includes("Change") ? `${d.v > 0 ? "+" : ""}${d.v.toFixed(1)}%` : `${d.v.toFixed(2)} σ`);
            return `${period}: ${val} (mean of ${d.n} market-months${d.partial ? " — incomplete period" : ""})`;
          }
        }),
        ...(ref != null ? [Plot.ruleY([ref], {stroke: "#64748b", strokeDasharray: "3,3", strokeWidth: 1.2})] : [Plot.ruleY([0], {stroke: "#94a3b8", strokeWidth: 0.8})]),
      ]
    });
  } else {
    // Monthly continuous line series
    const mkts = [...new Set(rows.map((d) => d.market))];
    const mktColors = paletteRange(mkts.length);
    pPrices = Plot.plot({
      width: 880,
      height: 220,
      marginLeft: 65,
      marginRight: 130,
      x: {type: "utc", label: null, grid: true},
      y: {
        label,
        grid: true,
        tickFormat: (d) => ref == null ? formatNumCompactShort()(d) : (priceView.includes("Change") ? `${d > 0 ? "+" : ""}${d}%` : `${d.toFixed(1)}σ`)
      },
      color: {domain: mkts, range: mktColors, legend: true},
      marks: [
        Plot.lineY(rows, {x: "_t", y: "v", stroke: "market", z: "seg", strokeWidth: 1.6}),
        Plot.dot(rows, {
          x: "_t", y: "v", fill: "market", r: 2.5,
          channels: {
            Market: "market",
            Date: (d) => d.period_date,
            Value: (d) => ref == null ? `${Math.round(d.v).toLocaleString()} KES` : (priceView.includes("Change") ? `${d.v > 0 ? "+" : ""}${d.v.toFixed(1)}%` : `${d.v.toFixed(2)} σ`)
          },
          tip: {format: {x: false, y: false, fill: false, Market: true, Date: true, Value: true}}
        }),
        ...(ref != null ? [Plot.ruleY([ref], {stroke: "#64748b", strokeDasharray: "3,3", strokeWidth: 1.2})] : [Plot.ruleY([0], {stroke: "#94a3b8", strokeWidth: 0.8})]),
      ]
    });
  }

  const panelATitle = priceView === "Raw price"
    ? `A. Retail Market Prices Across Sentinel Hubs (${priceProduct} • ${county})`
    : priceView === "Change vs year earlier"
    ? `A. Year-on-Year Retail Price Inflation (% YoY Change • ${priceProduct} • ${county})`
    : `A. Seasonal Anomaly (Departure from Month Climatology in Standard Deviations • ${priceProduct} • ${county})`;

  if (!totRows.length) {
    return html`
      <div style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.85rem;">
        <div style="font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 700; color: #1e293b; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em;">
          ${panelATitle}
        </div>
        ${pPrices}
      </div>
    `;
  }

  // Panel B: Terms of Trade (ToT)
  const totMed = d3.median(totRows, (d) => d.tot) || 50;
  let pTot;
  if (priceAgg !== "Monthly lines") {
    // ToT summary bars aggregated by quarter or year
    const toToT = d3.max(totRows, (d) => d.t);
    const bucketToT = (d) => priceAgg === "Yearly bars"
      ? Date.UTC(d.year, 0, 1)
      : Date.UTC(d.year, Math.floor((d.month - 1) / 3) * 3, 1);
    const stepToT = priceAgg === "Yearly bars" ? [1, 0] : [0, 3];
    const dataEndToT = new Date(Date.UTC(toToT.getUTCFullYear(), toToT.getUTCMonth() + 1, 1));
    const aggToT = [...d3.rollup(totRows, (v) => ({v: d3.mean(v, (d) => d.tot), n: v.length}), bucketToT)]
      .map(([t0, o]) => {
        const d0 = new Date(t0);
        const xEnd = new Date(Date.UTC(d0.getUTCFullYear() + stepToT[0], d0.getUTCMonth() + stepToT[1], 1));
        return {
          x1: d0,
          x2: xEnd > dataEndToT ? dataEndToT : xEnd,
          partial: xEnd > dataEndToT,
          tot: o.v,
          n: o.n
        };
      }).sort((a, b) => a.x1 - b.x1);

    pTot = Plot.plot({
      width: 880,
      height: 190,
      marginLeft: 65,
      marginRight: 130,
      x: {type: "utc", label: "Date", grid: true},
      y: {label: `Mean kg Maize / Goat (${priceAgg === "Yearly bars" ? "Year" : "Quarter"})`, grid: true, domain: [0, Math.max(100, (d3.max(aggToT, (d) => d.tot) || 80) + 10)]},
      marks: [
        Plot.ruleY([totMed], {stroke: "#64748b", strokeDasharray: "4,4", strokeWidth: 1.2}),
        Plot.text([totMed], {frameAnchor: "left", text: () => `Normal Median (~${Math.round(totMed)} kg/goat)`, fill: "#64748b", fontSize: 10, dy: -6, dx: 4}),
        Plot.ruleY([25], {stroke: "#dc2626", strokeWidth: 1.4, strokeDasharray: "2,2"}),
        Plot.text([25], {frameAnchor: "left", text: () => "Emergency Collapse Threshold (25 kg)", fill: "#dc2626", fontSize: 10, dy: -6, dx: 4, fontWeight: 700}),
        Plot.rect(aggToT, {
          x1: "x1", x2: "x2", y1: () => 0, y2: "tot", inset: 1,
          fill: (d) => d.tot <= 25 ? "#dc2626" : (d.tot < totMed ? "#d97706" : "#059669"),
          fillOpacity: (d) => d.partial ? 0.55 : 0.85,
          stroke: (d) => d.tot <= 25 ? "#b91c1c" : (d.tot < totMed ? "#b45309" : "#047857"),
          strokeWidth: 0.5,
          tip: true,
          title: (d) => {
            const period = priceAgg === "Yearly bars" ? d.x1.getUTCFullYear() : `${d.x1.getUTCFullYear()} Q${Math.floor(d.x1.getUTCMonth()/3) + 1}`;
            return `${period}: ${d.tot.toFixed(1)} kg maize / goat (mean of ${d.n} months${d.partial ? " — incomplete period" : ""})`;
          }
        }),
      ]
    });
  } else {
    // ToT continuous line
    pTot = Plot.plot({
      width: 880,
      height: 190,
      marginLeft: 65,
      marginRight: 130,
      x: {type: "utc", label: "Date", grid: true},
      y: {label: "kg Maize / Goat", grid: true, domain: [0, Math.max(100, (d3.max(totRows, (d) => d.tot) || 80) + 10)]},
      marks: [
        Plot.ruleY([totMed], {stroke: "#64748b", strokeDasharray: "4,4", strokeWidth: 1.2}),
        Plot.text([totMed], {frameAnchor: "left", text: () => `Normal Median (~${Math.round(totMed)} kg/goat)`, fill: "#64748b", fontSize: 10, dy: -6, dx: 4}),
        Plot.ruleY([25], {stroke: "#dc2626", strokeWidth: 1.4, strokeDasharray: "2,2"}),
        Plot.text([25], {frameAnchor: "left", text: () => "Emergency Collapse Threshold (25 kg)", fill: "#dc2626", fontSize: 10, dy: -6, dx: 4, fontWeight: 700}),
        Plot.lineY(totRows, {x: "t", y: "tot", z: "seg", stroke: "#d97706", strokeWidth: 2}),
        Plot.dot(totRows, {
          x: "t", y: "tot", fill: "#d97706", stroke: "#ffffff", strokeWidth: 1, r: 3,
          channels: {
            Month: (d) => `${d.year}-${String(d.month).padStart(2, "0")}`,
            "Terms of Trade": (d) => `${d.tot.toFixed(1)} kg maize / goat`,
            "Goat Price": (d) => `${Math.round(d.goat).toLocaleString()} KES`,
            "Maize Price": (d) => `${Math.round(d.maize)} KES/kg`
          },
          tip: {format: {x: false, y: false, fill: false, Month: true, "Terms of Trade": true, "Goat Price": true, "Maize Price": true}}
        })
      ]
    });
  }

  const panelBTitle = `B. Pastoral Terms of Trade (ToT) Purchasing Power: 1 Medium Goat → Kilograms of Maize Grain (${priceAgg === "Monthly lines" ? "Monthly" : (priceAgg === "Yearly bars" ? "Annual Mean" : "Quarterly Mean")})`;

  return html`
    <div style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.85rem;">
      <div style="font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 700; color: #1e293b; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em;">
        ${panelATitle}
      </div>
      ${pPrices}
      <div style="font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 700; color: #1e293b; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; margin-top: 0.4rem;">
        ${panelBTitle}
      </div>
      ${pTot}
    </div>
  `;
}

// Mount Figure 4.4
{
  [county, priceProduct, priceView, priceMarkets, priceAgg, sec32PricesChart];
  const host = document.getElementById("plotPricesHost");
  if (host && sec32PricesChart) {
    host.replaceChildren(sec32PricesChart);
  }
  const footerHost = document.getElementById("fig44FooterHost");
  if (footerHost) {
    const footer = plotFooter(
      `Retail commodity price dynamics and pastoral Terms of Trade purchasing power in ${county}.`,
      footerHost,
      {
        fig: "4.4",
        filename: `${county}_prices_and_terms_of_trade`,
        data: totRows.length ? totRows : (pricesView.rows || pricesSeg),
        about: `Monthly retail food and livestock prices from the FEWS NET Data Warehouse (USAID), marketpricefacts, across sentinel county markets (KES, 2000–2026). Terms of Trade (ToT) is DERIVED HERE, not a published series: median goat price (KES/head) divided by median maize-grain price (KES/kg) for the same county-month. Because it is a ratio, a fall can mean cheaper livestock OR dearer grain — opposite implications — so interpret it against the two price legs, not on its own. FEWS NET redistributes third-party series in the warehouse under the originating provider's terms; identify the collecting agency before republishing any series.`,
        meta: {County: county, Product: priceProduct, View: priceView, Aggregation: priceAgg}
      }
    );
    footerHost.replaceChildren(footer);
  }
}
sec32Table = {

    {
      epoch: "2005–2006 Drought",
      driver: "La Niña + Neutral IOD",

    },

            <td style="padding: 8px 10px; color: #334155; line-height: 1.4;">${r.impact}</td>

{

        meta: {County: county, Source: expSource, Metric: expMetric, Season: expSeason, Year: expYear, RP: expRP}

    );
    footerHost.replaceChildren(footer);
  }
}
sec33Table = {
  if (!expRows.length) return noDataPlaceholder(`No subcounty exposure records for ${county}.`);

    },
    rows: 10
  });
}

sec34RwFiltered = {
  const minYear = 2010;
  let data = rwByYear.filter((d) => d.year >= minYear);

// Figure 4.6 Chart Generator
sec34RwChart = {
  if (!sec34RwFiltered.length) {
    return noDataPlaceholder(`No ReliefWeb disaster reports recorded for ${county} matching the active filters.`);
  }

  const minYear = 2010;
  const yEnd = d3.max(sec34RwFiltered, (d) => d.year) || 2026;
  const ymax = d3.max([...d3.rollup(sec34RwFiltered, (v) => d3.sum(v, (d) => d.n), (d) => d.year)].map(([, n]) => n)) || 1;

  const chart = Plot.plot({
    width: 880,
    height: 300,
    marginLeft: 65,
    marginRight: 35,
    x: {
      domain: [minYear - 0.5, yEnd + 0.5],
      ticks: d3.range(minYear, yEnd + 1),
      tickFormat: "d",
      label: null,
      grid: false
    },
    y: {
      label: "Published Humanitarian Reports / Appeals",
      grid: true,
      domain: [0, Math.max(5, ymax * 1.15)]
    },
    color: {
      domain: ["Drought", "Flood", "Epidemic", "Other"],
      range: ["#d95f0e", "#2563eb", "#7b3294", "#94a3b8"],
      legend: true
    },
    marks: [
      Plot.rectY(sec34RwFiltered, {
        x1: (d) => d.year - 0.45,
        x2: (d) => d.year + 0.45,
        y: "n",
        fill: "cat",
        rx: 2,
        inset: 0.5,
        channels: {
          Year: "year",
          Category: "cat",
          Reports: "n"
        },
        tip: {format: {x: false, y: false, fill: false, Year: true, Category: true, Reports: true}}
      }),
      Plot.ruleY([0], {stroke: "#94a3b8", strokeWidth: 1})
    ]
  });

  return chart;
}

sec34RwTableRows = {

  return rwCty.filter((d) => {

    }
    return true;
  });
}

sec34RwTable = {
  if (!sec34RwTableRows.length) {
    return html`<div style="color: #64748b; font-style: italic; padding: 1.25rem 0.5rem;">No disaster reports matching active criteria in ${county}.</div>`;
  }

  const topRows = sec34RwTableRows.slice(0, 15);
  const rowsHtml = topRows.map((d) => {
    const cat = rwCat(d.disaster_type);
    const badgeColor = cat === "Drought" ? "background: #fed7aa; color: #9a3412;"
      : cat === "Flood" ? "background: #bfdbfe; color: #1e40af;"
      : cat === "Epidemic" ? "background: #e9d5ff; color: #6b21a8;"

    return html`<tr style="border-bottom: 1px solid #f1f5f9;">

      <td style="padding: 7px 10px;">

        <span style="font-size: 0.72rem; color: #94a3b8; margin-left: 4px;">&#x2197;</span>
      </td>

  return html`

      <table class="table table-sm table-hover" style="width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-bottom: 0.25rem;">
        <thead>

          </tr>

        <tbody>

      <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; font-size: 0.78rem; color: #64748b; padding-top: 0.35rem;">
        <span>Showing <strong>${topRows.length}</strong> of <strong>${sec34RwTableRows.length}</strong> situation reports for ${county}.</span>
        <span>Source: UN OCHA ReliefWeb (CC-BY-3.0-IGO / OCHA Terms)</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  `;

sec5LiveHero = {
  const isOND = (activeSeason === "OND");
  const targetSea = isOND ? "OND" : (stateProbs && stateProbs.some((d) => d.season === "MAM") ? "MAM" : "FMA");
  const probRow = (stateProbs && stateProbs.length) ? stateProbs.find((d) => d.season === targetSea) : null;
  // Outlook calendar from the data: latest RONI season year, else the CPC issue year
  const outlookYear = currentState?.outlookYear
    ?? (probRow?.issued ? parseInt(String(probRow.issued).trim().split(" ").pop(), 10) : new Date().getUTCFullYear());
  const ondLabel = `OND ${outlookYear}`;
  const mamLabel = `MAM ${outlookYear + 1}`;
  const spanLabel = `${outlookYear}/${String(outlookYear + 1).slice(2)}`;

  const pElNino = probRow ? probRow.el_nino : 0;
  const pNeutral = probRow ? probRow.neutral : 0;
  const pLaNina = probRow ? probRow.la_nina : 0;
  const issuedDate = probRow?.issued || "pending";

  const obsRoni = (currentState && currentState.roni != null) 
    ? `${currentState.roni >= 0 ? "+" : ""}${currentState.roni.toFixed(2)}` 
    : "Pending";
  const obsDmi = (currentState && currentState.dmi != null) 
    ? `${currentState.dmi >= 0 ? "+" : ""}${currentState.dmi.toFixed(2)}` 
    : "Pending";
  const roniNum = (currentState && currentState.roni != null) ? currentState.roni : null;
  const roniStateTag = roniNum != null 
    ? (roniNum >= 0.5 ? "El Niño (Warm Anomaly)" : roniNum <= -0.5 ? "La Niña (Cold Anomaly)" : "Neutral")
    : "Pending Observation";
  const dmiNum = (currentState && currentState.dmi != null) ? currentState.dmi : null;
  const dmiStateTag = dmiNum != null
    ? (dmiNum >= 0.4 ? "Positive Dipole" : dmiNum <= -0.4 ? "Negative Dipole" : "Neutral Dipole (±0.40 °C)")
    : "Pending Observation";

  const dominantPhase = pElNino >= pNeutral && pElNino >= pLaNina ? "El Niño" : pLaNina >= pNeutral ? "La Niña" : "Neutral";
  const dominantPct = Math.max(pElNino, pNeutral, pLaNina);

  let projDesc = "";
  if (targetSea === "OND") {
    if (dominantPhase === "El Niño") {
      projDesc = `Official NOAA CPC probabilistic forecast projects dominant El Niño conditions (${dominantPct}%) during ${ondLabel}. Equatorial Pacific warming coupled with positive/neutral Indian Ocean Dipole historically favors enhanced rainfall, riverine flooding risk, and pasture flushes across Kenya.`;
    } else if (dominantPhase === "La Niña") {
      projDesc = `Official NOAA CPC probabilistic forecast projects elevated La Niña probabilities (${dominantPct}%) during ${ondLabel}. Central Pacific cooling historically increases the risk of suppressed Short Rains and forage depletion in pastoral ASALs.`;
    } else {
      projDesc = `Official NOAA CPC probabilistic forecast projects ENSO-neutral conditions (${dominantPct}%) during ${ondLabel}. Near-average Pacific forcing allows localized Indian Ocean dynamics and intra-seasonal atmospheric waves to steer seasonal rainfall.`;
    }
  } else {
    projDesc = `Official NOAA CPC forecast projects ${dominantPhase} (${dominantPct}%) through the ${mamLabel} window. In equatorial East Africa, Pacific ENSO teleconnection skill drops near zero during MAM; regional planning must anchor directly to Western-V dynamics and downscaled KMSA bulletins.`;
  }

  return html`
    <div class="card" style="border-top: 4px solid var(--atlas-color-primary); background: linear-gradient(180deg, #ffffff 0%, #f8fafc 100%); box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.06); padding: 1.25rem 1.5rem; margin-bottom: 0;">
      <div class="card-header" style="border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0; padding-bottom: 0.85rem; margin-bottom: 1rem; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-start; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.75rem;">
        <div>
          <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 0.35rem; flex-wrap: wrap;">
            <span style="background: #ef4444; color: #fff; font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 800; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px;">
              <span style="width: 7px; height: 7px; background: #fff; border-radius: 50%; display: inline-block;"></span>
              Live Climate Driver Telemetry
            </span>
            <span style="background: #f1f5f9; color: #334155; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 700; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px;">
              ● Observations: RONI ${currentState?.roniSeason || 'pending'} &bull; DMI ${currentState?.dmiMonthYear || 'pending'}
            </span>
            <span style="font-size: 0.78rem; color: #475569; font-weight: 600;">
              NOAA Forecast Issued: <strong>${issuedDate}</strong>
            </span>
          </div>
          <h2 class="card-title" style="font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 800; color: #0f172a; margin: 0;">
            Active Ocean Driver Telemetry &amp; NOAA CPC Forward Teleconnection Outlook (${spanLabel})
          </h2>
          <p class="card-subtitle" style="font-size: 0.84rem; color: #475569; margin: 0.25rem 0 0;">
            Real-time monitoring of equatorial Pacific ENSO (Relative ONI) and Indian Ocean Dipole (DMI) coupled with official NOAA CPC probabilistic seasonal projections for Kenya's ${isOND ? "Short Rains (OND)" : "Long Rains (MAM)"}.
          </p>
        </div>
        <div style="display: flex; gap: 0.5rem; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap;">
          <a href="https://www.cpc.ncep.noaa.gov/data/indices/" target="_blank" rel="noopener" class="tool-action-link" style="font-size: 0.76rem; padding: 4px 8px; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius: 4px; font-weight: 600;">
            NOAA CPC Indices &rarr;
          </a>
          <a href="https://www.cpc.ncep.noaa.gov/products/international/ocean_monitoring/indian/IODMI/" target="_blank" rel="noopener" class="tool-action-link" style="font-size: 0.76rem; padding: 4px 8px; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius: 4px; font-weight: 600;">
            CPC ERSSTv6 DMI &rarr;
          </a>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(290px, 1fr)); gap: 1rem; width: 100%;">
        <!-- Column 1: Pacific Teleconnection (RONI) -->
        <div style="background: #f0f9ff; border: 1px solid #bae6fd; border-radius: 8px; padding: 1.1rem 1.25rem; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between;">
          <div>
            <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; margin-bottom: 0.35rem;">
              <span style="font-size: 0.76rem; font-weight: 800; color: #0369a1; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em;">
                Equatorial Pacific &bull; RONI
              </span>
              <span style="font-size: 0.72rem; color: #0284c7; background: #e0f2fe; padding: 2px 7px; border-radius: 9999px; font-weight: 700;">
                ${currentState?.roniSeason || 'Latest Published'}
              </span>
            </div>
            <div style="display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 8px; margin: 0.25rem 0; flex-wrap: wrap;">
              <span style="font-size: 1.85rem; font-weight: 800; color: #0284c7; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;">
                ${obsRoni} °C
              </span>
              <span style="font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 700; color: #0369a1;">
                ${roniStateTag}
              </span>
              <span style="background: ${currentState?.roniTrend === 'warming' ? '#fee2e2' : '#eff6ff'}; color: ${currentState?.roniTrend === 'warming' ? '#dc2626' : '#2563eb'}; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 700; padding: 2px 7px; border-radius: 9999px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 3px;" title="Trajectory: ${currentState?.roniDelta >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${currentState?.roniDelta?.toFixed(2)} °C">
                ${currentState?.roniArrow} ${currentState?.roniTrend === 'warming' ? 'Warming' : currentState?.roniTrend === 'cooling' ? 'Cooling' : 'Steady'} (${currentState?.roniDelta >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${currentState?.roniDelta?.toFixed(2)} °C)
              </span>
            </div>
            <div style="font-size: 0.74rem; color: #0369a1; background: #e0f2fe; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 4px; margin: 0.35rem 0 0.4rem; font-weight: 600;">
              Predictor Window (D17.2): <strong>${currentState?.predStatus}</strong>
            </div>
            <p style="font-size: 0.79rem; color: #334155; line-height: 1.45; margin: 0.2rem 0 0.6rem;">
              Relative Oceanic Niño Index (RONI) tracks central Pacific SST anomalies relative to tropical mean warming.
            </p>
          </div>
          <div style="border-top: 1px solid #e0f2fe; padding-top: 0.5rem; font-size: 0.72rem; color: #64748b; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;">
            <span>Source: <strong>NOAA CPC</strong> (RONI ${currentState?.roniSeason})</span>
            <a href="https://www.cpc.ncep.noaa.gov/products/analysis_monitoring/enso/roni/" target="_blank" rel="noopener" style="color: #0284c7; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none;">RONI Spec &rarr;</a>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Column 2: Indian Ocean Dipole (DMI) -->
        <div style="background: #f8fafc; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 8px; padding: 1.1rem 1.25rem; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between;">
          <div>
            <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; margin-bottom: 0.35rem;">
              <span style="font-size: 0.76rem; font-weight: 800; color: #334155; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em;">
                Indian Ocean &bull; NOAA CPC ERSSTv6 DMI
              </span>
              <span style="font-size: 0.72rem; color: #475569; background: #e2e8f0; padding: 2px 7px; border-radius: 9999px; font-weight: 700;">
                ${currentState?.dmiMonthYear || 'Latest Published'}
              </span>
            </div>
            <div style="display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 8px; margin: 0.25rem 0; flex-wrap: wrap;">
              <span style="font-size: 1.85rem; font-weight: 800; color: #334155; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;">
                ${obsDmi} °C
              </span>
              <span style="font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 700; color: #475569;">
                ${dmiStateTag}
              </span>
              <span style="background: ${currentState?.dmiTrend === 'cooling' ? '#dbeafe' : '#fee2e2'}; color: ${currentState?.dmiTrend === 'cooling' ? '#2563eb' : '#dc2626'}; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 700; padding: 2px 7px; border-radius: 9999px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 3px;" title="1-month trajectory: ${currentState?.dmiDelta >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${currentState?.dmiDelta?.toFixed(2)} °C/mo">
                ${currentState?.dmiArrow} ${currentState?.dmiTrend === 'cooling' ? 'Cooling' : currentState?.dmiTrend === 'warming' ? 'Warming' : 'Steady'} (${currentState?.dmiDelta >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${currentState?.dmiDelta?.toFixed(2)} °C/mo)
              </span>
            </div>
            <p style="font-size: 0.79rem; color: #334155; line-height: 1.45; margin: 0.4rem 0 0.6rem;">
              Dipole Mode Index from NOAA CPC ERSSTv6 (1991–2020 climatology): west-minus-east equatorial Indian Ocean SST anomaly; positive values add thermal forcing over the western basin.
            </p>
          </div>
          <div style="border-top: 1px solid #e2e8f0; padding-top: 0.5rem; font-size: 0.72rem; color: #64748b; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;">
            <span>Source: <strong>NOAA CPC ERSSTv6</strong> (Obs: ${currentState?.dmiMonthYear})</span>
            <a href="https://www.cpc.ncep.noaa.gov/products/international/ocean_monitoring/indian/IODMI/" target="_blank" rel="noopener" style="color: #475569; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none;">CPC DMI &rarr;</a>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Column 3: Forward Probabilistic Outlook -->
        <div style="background: #fffbeb; border: 1px solid #fde68a; border-radius: 8px; padding: 1.1rem 1.25rem; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between;">
          <div>
            <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; margin-bottom: 0.35rem;">
              <span style="font-size: 0.76rem; font-weight: 800; color: #92400e; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em;">
                NOAA CPC Forward Projection (${targetSea === "OND" ? ondLabel : mamLabel})
              </span>
              <span style="font-size: 0.72rem; color: #92400e; background: #fef3c7; padding: 2px 7px; border-radius: 9999px; font-weight: 700;">
                Target Season
              </span>
            </div>
            <div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 6px; text-align: center; margin: 0.45rem 0;">
              <div style="background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #fcd34d; border-radius: 5px; padding: 6px 4px;">
                <div style="font-size: 0.68rem; font-weight: 700; color: #0369a1;">EL NIÑO</div>
                <div style="font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 800; color: #0284c7;">${pElNino}%</div>
              </div>
              <div style="background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #fcd34d; border-radius: 5px; padding: 6px 4px;">
                <div style="font-size: 0.68rem; font-weight: 700; color: #475569;">NEUTRAL</div>
                <div style="font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 800; color: #475569;">${pNeutral}%</div>
              </div>
              <div style="background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #fcd34d; border-radius: 5px; padding: 6px 4px;">
                <div style="font-size: 0.68rem; font-weight: 700; color: #b91c1c;">LA NIÑA</div>
                <div style="font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 800; color: #dc2626;">${pLaNina}%</div>
              </div>
            </div>
            <p style="font-size: 0.78rem; color: #78350f; line-height: 1.45; margin: 0.4rem 0 0.4rem;">
              ${projDesc}
            </p>
          </div>
          <div style="border-top: 1px solid #fde68a; padding-top: 0.5rem; font-size: 0.72rem; color: #92400e; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;">
            <span>Issued: <strong>${issuedDate}</strong> (NOAA CPC)</span>
            <a href="https://www.cpc.ncep.noaa.gov/products/analysis_monitoring/enso/roni/probabilities/" target="_blank" rel="noopener" style="color: #92400e; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none;">CPC Probability Spec &rarr;</a>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  `;
}

// Mount Live Telemetry Hero Card
{
  [activeSeason, stateProbs, currentState, sec5LiveHero];
  const host = document.getElementById("sec5LiveHeroHost");
  if (host && sec5LiveHero) {
    host.replaceChildren(sec5LiveHero);
  }
}
iriPlumeBundle = FileAttachment("/data/KE-enso-explorer/iri_forecast_plume.json").json()
iodPlumeBundle = FileAttachment("/data/KE-enso-explorer/iod_forecast_plume.json").json()

sec2PlumeHero = {
  if (!iriPlumeBundle || !iriPlumeBundle.current) {
    return html`<div style="padding: 1rem; color: #b91c1c;">Forecast Plume feed unavailable.</div>`;
  }

  const container = html`<div style="width: 100%;"></div>`;

  // Reactive default driver from global driverKind selector, can also be toggled locally
  let activeDriver = (driverKind && driverKind.includes("IOD")) ? "IOD" : "ENSO";
  let hindcastSeasons = 6;
  let overlayMode = "top3"; // "none", "top3", "top5"
  const analogueColors = ["#d97706", "#7c3aed", "#059669", "#0891b2", "#e11d48"];

  const seasons_order = ['DJF', 'JFM', 'FMA', 'MAM', 'AMJ', 'MJJ', 'JJA', 'JAS', 'ASO', 'SON', 'OND', 'NDJ'];

  // Forecast horizon comes from the bundles themselves (current.seasons + current.seasonYears,
  // written by scripts/fetch_iri_plume.py and _sources/sintex_iod_build.py) — no typed years.
  function bundleHorizon(b) {
    const seasons = (b && b.current && Array.isArray(b.current.seasons)) ? b.current.seasons : [];
    let years = (b && b.current && Array.isArray(b.current.seasonYears) && b.current.seasonYears.length === seasons.length)
      ? b.current.seasonYears : null;
    if (!years) {
      // legacy bundle without seasonYears: seasons belong to the issue year until the DJF rollover
      let y = (b && b.current && b.current.issueYear) || new Date().getUTCFullYear();
      years = seasons.map((s, i) => { if (i > 0 && s === 'DJF') y += 1; return y; });
    }
    return { seasons, years };
  }
  const horizonENSO = bundleHorizon(iriPlumeBundle);
  const horizonIOD = bundleHorizon(iodPlumeBundle);
  const horizonsWithData = [horizonENSO, horizonIOD].filter(h => h.years.length);
  const firstYear = horizonsWithData.length ? Math.min(...horizonsWithData.map(h => h.years[0])) : new Date().getUTCFullYear();
  const lastYear = horizonsWithData.length ? Math.max(...horizonsWithData.map(h => h.years[h.years.length - 1])) : firstYear + 1;
  // Calendar window: SON two years before the first forecast year .. end of the last forecast year
  const all_seasons = [];
  for (const y of d3.range(firstYear - 2, lastYear + 1)) {
    for (const s of seasons_order) {
      if (y === firstYear - 2 && seasons_order.indexOf(s) < seasons_order.indexOf('SON')) continue;
      const short_y = String(y).slice(2);
      all_seasons.push({
        season: s,
        year: y,
        id: s + '_' + y,
        label: s + " '" + short_y
      });
    }
  }
  // trim the window to the last forecast season of either bundle
  {
    const lastIds = horizonsWithData.map(h => `${h.seasons[h.seasons.length - 1]}_${h.years[h.years.length - 1]}`);
    const cut = Math.max(...lastIds.map(id => all_seasons.findIndex(s => s.id === id)));
    if (cut >= 0) all_seasons.length = cut + 1;
  }

  function renderPlume() {
    const isIOD = (activeDriver === "IOD");
    const bundle = isIOD ? iodPlumeBundle : iriPlumeBundle;
    if (!bundle || !bundle.current) return;

    const themeColor = isIOD ? "#0f766e" : "#2563eb";
    const themeBg = isIOD ? "#f0fdfa" : "#eff6ff";
    const ribbonColor = isIOD ? "#99f6e4" : "#93c5fd";

    // Build observed map dynamically from seasonalDrivers (Decision D17.1 & D17.4)
    const obs_map = {};
    for (const s of all_seasons) {
      const driverKey = isIOD 
        ? (`DMI_CPC_${s.season}_${s.year}`)
        : `RONI_${s.season}_${s.year}`;
      let val = seasonalDriverMap ? seasonalDriverMap.get(driverKey) : null;
      if (val == null && isIOD && seasonalDriverMap) {
        val = seasonalDriverMap.get(`DMI_${s.season}_${s.year}`);
      }
      if (val != null) {
        obs_map[s.id] = val;
      }
    }

    const latestObsVal = isIOD 
      ? (currentState?.dmiLatest ?? null)
      : (currentState?.roniLatest ?? null);

    // Forward forecast ensemble statistics for the bundle's own forecast seasons
    const horizon = isIOD ? horizonIOD : horizonENSO;
    const fcstSeasons = horizon.seasons;
    const fcstYears = horizon.years;
    const firstFcstYear = fcstYears[0];
    const fcstStats = [];

    // Anchor at the season immediately before the first forecast season (e.g. JAS before ASO):
    // its observed value from the driver parquets if published, else the latest observed value.
    const firstFcstPos = all_seasons.findIndex(s => s.id === `${fcstSeasons[0]}_${firstFcstYear}`);
    const anchorSeason = firstFcstPos > 0 ? all_seasons[firstFcstPos - 1] : null;
    const anchorVal = anchorSeason ? (obs_map[anchorSeason.id] ?? latestObsVal) : latestObsVal;
    if (anchorSeason && anchorVal != null) {
      fcstStats.push({
        label: anchorSeason.label,
        season: anchorSeason.season,
        year: anchorSeason.year,
        min: anchorVal,
        max: anchorVal,
        median: anchorVal,
        mean: anchorVal,
        count: bundle.current.models.length
      });
    }

    fcstSeasons.forEach((s, idx) => {
      const sy = fcstYears[idx];
      const vals = bundle.current.models
        .map(m => m.data[idx])
        .filter(v => v != null)
        .sort((a,b) => a - b);
      if (vals.length > 0) {
        fcstStats.push({
          label: s + " '" + String(sy).slice(2),
          season: s,
          year: sy,
          min: d3.min(vals),
          max: d3.max(vals),
          median: d3.median(vals),
          mean: d3.mean(vals),
          count: vals.length
        });
      }
    });

    const firstFcstIdx = firstFcstPos;
    let startIdx = firstFcstIdx - hindcastSeasons;
    if (hindcastSeasons === 0) startIdx = firstFcstIdx - 1; // anchor at the season before the first forecast
    startIdx = Math.max(0, startIdx);

    const visibleSeasons = all_seasons.slice(startIdx);
    const domainLabels = visibleSeasons.map(s => s.label);

    const visibleObs = [];
    visibleSeasons.forEach(s => {
      if (obs_map[s.id] != null && all_seasons.indexOf(s) < firstFcstIdx) {
        visibleObs.push({ label: s.label, val: obs_map[s.id] });
      }
    });

    const isOND = (activeSeason === "OND");
    const targetCode = isOND ? 'OND' : 'MAM';
    const targetIdx = fcstSeasons.indexOf(targetCode);
    const targetYear = targetIdx >= 0 ? fcstYears[targetIdx] : (isOND ? firstFcstYear : firstFcstYear + 1);
    const targetSeasonKey = `${targetCode}_${targetYear}`;
    const targetSeasonLabel = `${targetCode} '${String(targetYear).slice(2)}`;
    const targetSeasonTitle = isOND ? `OND ${targetYear} (Short Rains)` : `MAM ${targetYear} (Long Rains)`;

    const targetStat = fcstStats.find(d => d.season === targetCode && d.year === targetYear) || fcstStats.find(d => d.season === targetCode) || null;
    const targetMedian = targetStat ? targetStat.median : null;
    const targetMin = targetStat ? targetStat.min : null;
    const targetMax = targetStat ? targetStat.max : null;
    const fmtSigned = (v) => (v == null || !Number.isFinite(v)) ? 'n/a' : `${v >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${v.toFixed(2)}`;
    // Monthly products: the next issue is expected around the 20th of the month after the release month.
    const nextIssueNote = (b) => {
      const ry = b?.metadata?.releaseYear, rm = b?.metadata?.releaseMonth;
      if (!ry || !rm) return 'next issue: monthly';
      const d = new Date(Date.UTC(ry, rm, 20));
      return `next issue expected ~${d.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'short', year: 'numeric', timeZone: 'UTC' })}`;
    };

    const targetVals = bundle.current.models.map(m => m.data[targetIdx]).filter(v => v != null);

    // Agreement %
    let targetAgreementText = "";
    if (isIOD) {
      const neutralCount = targetVals.filter(v => v >= -0.4 && v <= 0.4).length;
      const pct = Math.round((neutralCount / targetVals.length) * 100);
      targetAgreementText = `${pct}% Neutral IOD (-0.4 to +0.4 °C)`;
    } else {
      const elNinoCount = targetVals.filter(v => v >= 0.5).length;
      const pct = Math.round((elNinoCount / targetVals.length) * 100);
      targetAgreementText = `${pct}% El Niño (> +0.5 °C)`;
    }

    const targetAverages = bundle.current.averages || {};
    const dynAvg = targetIdx >= 0 ? (targetAverages.dynamical?.[targetIdx] ?? null) : null;
    const statAvg = targetIdx >= 0 ? (targetAverages.statistical?.[targetIdx] ?? null) : null;

    // Thresholds and domains
    const threshUpper = isIOD ? 0.4 : 0.5;
    const threshLower = isIOD ? -0.4 : -0.5;
    const yDomain = isIOD ? [-1.5, 1.5] : [-2.0, 4.4];
    const yLabel = isIOD ? "↑ Dipole Mode Index (DMI, °C)" : "↑ Niño 3.4 SST Anomaly (°C)";

    const marks = [
      // Background Phase Zones
      Plot.rectY([{y1: threshUpper, y2: yDomain[1]}], {y1: "y1", y2: "y2", fill: "#fef2f2", fillOpacity: 0.65}),
      Plot.rectY([{y1: threshLower, y2: threshUpper}], {y1: "y1", y2: "y2", fill: "#f8fafc", fillOpacity: 0.5}),
      Plot.rectY([{y1: yDomain[0], y2: threshLower}], {y1: "y1", y2: "y2", fill: "#f0f9ff", fillOpacity: 0.65}),

      // Reference Rules
      Plot.ruleY([threshUpper], {stroke: "#dc2626", strokeDasharray: "3,3", strokeWidth: 1.2}),
      Plot.ruleY([threshLower], {stroke: "#0284c7", strokeDasharray: "3,3", strokeWidth: 1.2}),
      Plot.ruleY([0], {stroke: "#94a3b8", strokeWidth: 1}),

      // Highlight target season column
      Plot.ruleX([targetSeasonLabel], {
        stroke: isIOD ? "#0f766e" : "#2563eb",
        strokeWidth: 46,
        strokeOpacity: 0.12
      }),
      Plot.ruleX([targetSeasonLabel], {
        stroke: isIOD ? "#0d9488" : "#3b82f6",
        strokeWidth: 1.5,
        strokeDasharray: "4,4"
      }),
      Plot.text([targetSeasonLabel], {
        y: () => yDomain[1],
        text: () => `★ Focus: ${targetSeasonLabel}`,
        dy: 12,
        fill: isIOD ? "#0f766e" : "#1d4ed8",
        fontWeight: 800,
        fontSize: 10.5,
        textAnchor: "middle"
      }),

      // Shaded Multi-Model Ensemble Spread Ribbon (Min to Max)
      Plot.areaY(fcstStats, {
        x: "label",
        y1: "min",
        y2: "max",
        fill: ribbonColor,
        fillOpacity: 0.5,
        title: d => `${d.label} Ensemble Spread: ${d.min >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${d.min.toFixed(2)} to ${d.max >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${d.max.toFixed(2)} °C`
      }),

      // Multi-Model Ensemble Median Line
      Plot.line(fcstStats, {
        x: "label",
        y: "median",
        stroke: themeColor,
        strokeWidth: 2.8
      }),
      Plot.dot(fcstStats, {
        x: "label",
        y: "median",
        fill: themeColor,
        stroke: "#ffffff",
        strokeWidth: 1.2,
        r: 4,
        title: d => `${d.label} Ensemble Median: ${d.median >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${d.median.toFixed(2)} °C (Spread: ${d.min >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${d.min.toFixed(2)} to ${d.max >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${d.max.toFixed(2)} °C; ${bundle.current.models.length} models)`
      }),

      // Observed Line and Dots
      Plot.line(visibleObs, {
        x: "label",
        y: "val",
        stroke: "#0f172a",
        strokeWidth: 2.2
      }),
      Plot.dot(visibleObs, {
        x: "label",
        y: "val",
        fill: "#0f172a",
        stroke: "#ffffff",
        strokeWidth: 1.2,
        r: 4,
        title: d => `Observed ${d.label}: ${d.val >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${d.val.toFixed(2)} °C`
      })
    ];

    if (!isIOD) {
      marks.push(Plot.ruleY([2.0], {stroke: "#b91c1c", strokeDasharray: "2,4", strokeWidth: 0.9}));
    }

    // Overlay Historical Analogue Traces if enabled
    let topAnalogues = [];
    if (overlayMode !== "none") {
      const topN = (overlayMode === "top3") ? 3 : 5;
      topAnalogues = (analogueYears && analogueYears.length) ? analogueYears.slice(0, topN) : [];

      topAnalogues.forEach((a, aIdx) => {
        const col = analogueColors[aIdx % analogueColors.length];
        const pts = [];
        visibleSeasons.forEach(s => {
          const yrOffset = s.year - firstFcstYear;
          const targetHistYear = a.year + yrOffset;
          const key = `${isIOD ? 'DMI' : 'RONI'}_${s.season}_${targetHistYear}`;
          const val = seasonalDriverMap ? seasonalDriverMap.get(key) : null;
          if (val != null) {
            pts.push({ label: s.label, season: s.season, val: val, year: a.year, rank: a.rank, color: col });
          }
        });

        if (pts.length > 0) {
          const anchorPts = pts.filter(p => p.season === "OND" || p.season === "ASO");
          marks.push(
            Plot.line(pts, {
              x: "label",
              y: "val",
              stroke: col,
              strokeWidth: 2.0,
              strokeDasharray: "4,3",
              title: d => `${a.year} (#${a.rank} Analogue) ${d.label}: ${d.val >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${d.val.toFixed(2)} °C`
            }),
            Plot.dot(anchorPts, {
              x: "label",
              y: "val",
              fill: col,
              stroke: "#ffffff",
              strokeWidth: 1.2,
              r: 4.0,
              title: d => `${a.year} (#${a.rank} Analogue) ${d.label} Anchor: ${d.val >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${d.val.toFixed(2)} °C`
            })
          );
          // Direct terminal label at the right margin to avoid any OND text collisions
          const termPt = pts[pts.length - 1];
          if (termPt) {
            marks.push(
              Plot.text([termPt], {
                x: "label",
                y: "val",
                text: d => `${a.year} (#${a.rank})`,
                fill: col,
                fontWeight: 700,
                fontSize: 9.5,
                dx: 8,
                textAnchor: "start",
                paintOrder: "stroke",
                stroke: "#ffffff",
                strokeWidth: 3
              })
            );
          }
        }
      });
    }

    const plotSvg = Plot.plot({
      width: 1040,
      height: 345,
      marginTop: 25,
      marginRight: 75,
      marginBottom: 44,
      marginLeft: 55,
      x: {
        domain: domainLabels,
        label: null,
        tickRotate: domainLabels.length > 10 ? -40 : 0
      },
      y: {
        domain: yDomain,
        label: yLabel,
        grid: true
      },
      marks: marks
    });

    // Gauge calculation
    let gaugeVal, gaugePct, gaugeTag, gaugeColor, gaugeBg;
    if (isIOD) {
      gaugeVal = (currentState && currentState.dmiLatest != null) ? currentState.dmiLatest : null;
      if (gaugeVal != null) {
        gaugePct = Math.max(2, Math.min(98, ((gaugeVal - (-1.5)) / 3.0) * 100));
        gaugeTag = gaugeVal >= 0.8 ? "Strong Positive IOD" : gaugeVal >= 0.4 ? "Positive IOD" : gaugeVal <= -0.8 ? "Strong Negative IOD" : gaugeVal <= -0.4 ? "Negative IOD" : "Neutral IOD";
        gaugeColor = gaugeVal >= 0.4 ? "#dc2626" : gaugeVal <= -0.4 ? "#2563eb" : "#475569";
        gaugeBg = gaugeVal >= 0.4 ? "#fee2e2" : gaugeVal <= -0.4 ? "#dbeafe" : "#f1f5f9";
      } else {
        gaugePct = 50;
        gaugeTag = "Pending Observation";
        gaugeColor = "#64748b";
        gaugeBg = "#f1f5f9";
      }
    } else {
      gaugeVal = (currentState && currentState.roniLatest != null) ? currentState.roniLatest : null;
      if (gaugeVal != null) {
        gaugePct = Math.max(2, Math.min(98, ((gaugeVal - (-2.0)) / 4.0) * 100));
        gaugeTag = gaugeVal >= 2.0 ? "Super El Niño" : gaugeVal >= 1.5 ? "Strong El Niño" : gaugeVal >= 0.5 ? "Moderate El Niño" : gaugeVal <= -1.5 ? "Strong La Niña" : gaugeVal <= -0.5 ? "Weak La Niña" : "Neutral";
        gaugeColor = gaugeVal >= 0.5 ? "#dc2626" : gaugeVal <= -0.5 ? "#2563eb" : "#475569";
        gaugeBg = gaugeVal >= 0.5 ? "#fee2e2" : gaugeVal <= -0.5 ? "#dbeafe" : "#f1f5f9";
      } else {
        gaugePct = 50;
        gaugeTag = "Pending Observation";
        gaugeColor = "#64748b";
        gaugeBg = "#f1f5f9";
      }
    }

    container.innerHTML = `
      <div class="card" style="border-top: 4px solid ${themeColor}; background: #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.06); padding: 1.25rem 1.5rem; margin-bottom: 1.5rem;">
        
        <!-- Ocean Driver Switcher Bar -->
        <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 0.85rem; border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0; padding-bottom: 0.75rem; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.5rem;">
          <div style="display: inline-flex; gap: 6px; background: #f1f5f9; padding: 3px; border-radius: 6px;">
            <button type="button" class="btn-driver-tab ${!isIOD ? 'active' : ''}" id="btnDriverEnso" style="${!isIOD ? 'background: #0284c7 !important; color: #fff !important; border-color: #0369a1 !important;' : ''}">
              🌊 Pacific ENSO (Niño 3.4)
            </button>
            <button type="button" class="btn-driver-tab ${isIOD ? 'active' : ''}" id="btnDriverIod" style="${isIOD ? 'background: #0f766e !important; color: #fff !important; border-color: #0d9488 !important;' : ''}">
              🌊 Indian Ocean Dipole (DMI)
            </button>
          </div>
          <div style="font-size: 0.74rem; color: #64748b; font-weight: 500;">
            ${isIOD 
              ? `Coupled Global Dynamical Ensemble: <strong>JAMSTEC SINTEX-F (${bundle.current.models.length} Members)</strong>` 
              : 'Global Multi-Model Ensemble: <strong>Columbia Climate School IRI • NOAA CPC</strong>'}
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Header -->
        <div style="border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0; padding-bottom: 0.85rem; margin-bottom: 1rem; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-start; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.75rem;">
          <div>
            <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 0.35rem; flex-wrap: wrap;">
              <span class="enso-figure-number" style="background: ${themeColor}; color: #fff; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 800; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 4px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em;">
                Figure 2.0
              </span>
              <span style="background: ${themeColor}15; color: ${themeColor}; font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 800; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; border: 1px solid ${themeColor}33;">
                ${isIOD ? 'Indian Ocean Dynamical Ensemble' : 'Pacific Multi-Model Ensemble'}
              </span>
              <span style="font-size: 0.78rem; color: #475569; font-weight: 600;">
                ${isIOD ? `JAMSTEC SINTEX-F Dynamical Prediction • ${iodPlumeBundle?.metadata?.issueLabel || 'initialisation pending'} • ${bundle.current.models.length} Members` : `CCSR/IRI ENSO Prediction Plume • Issued ${iriPlumeBundle?.metadata?.issueLabel || 'pending'} • ${bundle.current.models.length} Models`}
              </span>
            </div>
            <h2 style="font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 800; color: #0f172a; margin: 0;">
              ${isIOD 
                ? 'Indian Ocean Dipole (DMI) SST Anomaly — JAMSTEC SINTEX-F Forecast Plume & Trajectory' 
                : 'Equatorial Pacific Niño 3.4 SST Anomaly — Multi-Model Forecast Plume & Trajectory'}
            </h2>
            <p style="font-size: 0.84rem; color: #475569; margin: 0.25rem 0 0;">
              ${isIOD 
                ? `JAMSTEC SINTEX-F dynamical ocean-atmosphere ensemble forecast (${bundle.current.models.length} members) with min–max spread, observed Dipole Mode Index (DMI) trajectory, and historical analogue traces.` 
                : 'Consensus multi-model ensemble forecast with min–max spread, observed sea surface temperature trajectory, and historical analogue traces.'}
            </p>
          </div>
          <div style="display: flex; gap: 0.5rem; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap;">
            ${isIOD ? `
              <a href="https://www.jamstec.go.jp/virtualearth/general/en/" target="_blank" rel="noopener" style="font-size: 0.76rem; padding: 4px 8px; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius: 4px; font-weight: 600; color: #1e293b; text-decoration: none;">
                JAMSTEC SINTEX-F &rarr;
              </a>
              <a href="https://www.cpc.ncep.noaa.gov/products/international/ocean_monitoring/indian/IODMI/" target="_blank" rel="noopener" style="font-size: 0.76rem; padding: 4px 8px; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius: 4px; font-weight: 600; color: #1e293b; text-decoration: none;">
                NOAA CPC ERSSTv6 DMI &rarr;
              </a>
            ` : `
              <a href="https://iri.columbia.edu/our-expertise/climate/forecasts/enso/current/" target="_blank" rel="noopener" style="font-size: 0.76rem; padding: 4px 8px; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius: 4px; font-weight: 600; color: #1e293b; text-decoration: none;">
                Columbia IRI Plume &rarr;
              </a>
              <a href="https://www.cpc.ncep.noaa.gov/products/analysis_monitoring/enso/advisory/" target="_blank" rel="noopener" style="font-size: 0.76rem; padding: 4px 8px; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius: 4px; font-weight: 600; color: #1e293b; text-decoration: none;">
                NOAA CPC Advisory &rarr;
              </a>
            `}
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- State Position Gauge -->
        <div style="background: #f8fafc; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 6px; padding: 0.85rem 1.15rem; margin-bottom: 1rem;">
          <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.5rem;">
            <span style="font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 800; color: #1e293b; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em;">
              ${isIOD ? 'IOD State Gauge &bull; Current Dipole Mode Index (DMI) Position' : 'ENSO State Gauge &bull; Current Niño 3.4 Position'}
            </span>
            <span style="font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 800; color: ${gaugeColor}; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;">
              ${gaugeVal != null ? `${gaugeVal >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${gaugeVal.toFixed(2)} °C` : 'Pending'}
              <span style="font-size: 0.76rem; font-weight: 700; color: ${gaugeColor}; margin-left: 4px; background: ${gaugeBg}; padding: 2px 7px; border-radius: 9999px;">${gaugeTag}</span>
            </span>
          </div>
          
          <!-- Gradient Bar with Pin -->
          <div style="position: relative; margin: 1.2rem 0 0.5rem 0;">
            <div style="height: 14px; border-radius: 7px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #1d4ed8 0%, #38bdf8 25%, #94a3b8 45%, #cbd5e1 50%, #fca5a5 55%, #ef4444 75%, #991b1b 100%);"></div>
            
            <!-- Pointer Marker -->
            <div style="position: absolute; top: -14px; left: ${gaugePct}%; transform: translateX(-50%); display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; pointer-events: none;">

              </div>

          <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 0.68rem; font-weight: 700; color: #64748b; margin-top: 4px;">

              : '<span>-2.0°C (STRONG LA NIÑA)</span><span>-0.5°C</span><span>0.0°C (NEUTRAL)</span><span>+0.5°C</span><span>+1.5°C (STRONG EL NIÑO)</span><span>+2.0°C (SUPER)</span>'}
          </div>
        </div>

        <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.75rem; background: #f8fafc; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; padding: 0.5rem 0.85rem; border-radius: 6px; margin-bottom: 0.85rem;">
          
          <!-- Left: Hindcast Slider + Compact Presets -->
          <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap;">
            <span style="font-size: 0.76rem; font-weight: 700; color: #334155;">

            </span>
            <input type="range" min="0" max="18" value="${hindcastSeasons}" step="1" id="iriHindcastSlider" style="width: 110px; cursor: pointer;">
            <div style="display: inline-flex; gap: 4px;">
              <button class="btn-plume-pill ${hindcastSeasons === 0 ? 'active' : ''}" data-hc="0">Forecast only</button>
              <button class="btn-plume-pill ${hindcastSeasons === 6 ? 'active' : ''}" data-hc="6">6 mo (Default)</button>
              <button class="btn-plume-pill ${hindcastSeasons === 12 ? 'active' : ''}" data-hc="12">12 mo</button>
            </div>
          </div>

            <span style="font-size: 0.74rem; font-weight: 700; color: #475569;">Overlay Analogues:</span>

              <button class="btn-plume-pill ${overlayMode === 'none' ? 'active' : ''}" data-overlay="none">Off</button>
              <button class="btn-plume-pill ${overlayMode === 'top3' ? 'active' : ''}" data-overlay="top3">Top 3</button>

            </div>
